```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Helper function: Robust date parser
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  # Excel serials (roughly 1955–2064)
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  # Strings
  left <- !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  # Clamp to reasonable range
  bad <- is.na(out) | year(out) < 2000 | year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

# Build long ctDNA data from wide columns
build_ctdna_long <- function(dat, id_col) {
  # Check if ctDNA columns exist
  ctdna_value_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  ctdna_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(ctdna_value_cols) == 0 || length(ctdna_date_cols) == 0) {
    # Return empty tibble with correct structure
    return(tibble(
      !!id_col := character(0),
      ctdna_date = as.Date(character(0)),
      ctdna_value = numeric(0)
    ))
  }
  
  val <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), all_of(ctdna_value_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw))))) )
  dt  <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), all_of(ctdna_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw")
  out <- val %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dt %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date_raw),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date), !is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_date, ctdna_value) %>%
    arrange(.data[[id_col]], ctdna_date)
  out
}

# Clean therapy setting
clean_setting <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    y %in% c("neo","neoadjuvant","neoadjuvant therapy","neoadjuvant systemic therapy") ~ "Neoadjuvant",
    y %in% c("adjuvant","adjuvant therapy","adjuvant systemic therapy") ~ "Adjuvant",
    y %in% c("palliative","metastatic","1l metastatic","2l metastatic") ~ "Palliative",
    y %in% c("","na","n/a","unknown","other","other (see notes)") ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}

# Clean/harmonize regimen names
clean_regimen <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    str_detect(y, "enfortumab.*pembrolizumab|\\bev\\b.*\\bpemb|\\bev/pembro") ~ "Enfortumab Vedotin + Pembrolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*cis.*nivo") ~ "Gemcitabine + Cisplatin + Nivolumab",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*cis") ~ "Gemcitabine + Cisplatin",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*carb") ~ "Gemcitabine + Carboplatin",
    str_detect(y, "^nivolumab|\\bnivo\\b") ~ "Nivolumab",
    str_detect(y, "pembrolizumab|\\bpembro\\b") ~ "Pembrolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "atezolizumab|\\batezo\\b") ~ "Atezolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "durvalumab|\\bdurva\\b") ~ "Durvalumab",
    str_detect(y, "clinical trial") ~ "Clinical trial (other)",
    str_detect(y, "other \\(see notes\\)|^other$") ~ "Other (see notes)",
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}

# Categorize therapy type: ICI, ADC, Chemo, or combinations
categorize_therapy_type <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(x))
  has_ici <- str_detect(y, "nivolumab|pembrolizumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|avelumab|ipi|ipilimumab|tremelimumab|pd-1|pd-l1|ctla-4|checkpoint|immunotherapy")
  has_adc <- str_detect(y, "enfortumab|vedotin|sacituzumab|govitecan|t-dxd|trastuzumab.*deruxtecan|adc|antibody.*drug.*conjugate")
  has_chemo <- str_detect(y, "gemcitabine|cisplatin|carboplatin|paclitaxel|docetaxel|vinflunine|methotrexate|doxorubicin|cyclophosphamide|ifosfamide|mvac|ddmvac|chemotherapy|chemo")
  
  case_when(
    has_ici & has_adc & has_chemo ~ "ICI+ADC+Chemo",
    has_ici & has_adc ~ "ICI+ADC",
    has_ici & has_chemo ~ "ICI+Chemo",
    has_adc & has_chemo ~ "ADC+Chemo",
    has_ici ~ "ICI",
    has_adc ~ "ADC",
    has_chemo ~ "Chemo",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

# Parse T stage to numeric
parse_t_num <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "^TIS|^TA|^T0") ~ 0,
    str_detect(x, "^T1") ~ 1,
    str_detect(x, "^T2") ~ 2,
    str_detect(x, "^T3") ~ 3,
    str_detect(x, "^T4") ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
```

```{r load_and_combine_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Load and Combine Both Datasets
# ==============================

# Load dataset from Master1 (all patients now consolidated here)
file_path_master <- "Natera_Sheet_Master1.xlsx"
available_sheets_master <- excel_sheets(file_path_master)
sheet_name_master <- if ("Master_Sheet" %in% available_sheets_master) {
  "Master_Sheet"
} else if ("Sheet1" %in% available_sheets_master) {
  "Sheet1"
} else {
  available_sheets_master[1]
}
raw_master <- read_excel(file_path_master, sheet = sheet_name_master, col_names = FALSE)
var_names_master <- raw_master[[1]]
dat_master <- as.data.frame(t(raw_master[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(dat_master) <- make.unique(var_names_master, sep = "_")
dat_master <- clean_names(dat_master)

# Identify patient ID column
id_col_master <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat_master)) {
  "record_id_linking_key"
} else {
  id_candidates <- names(dat_master)[str_detect(names(dat_master), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(id_candidates) > 0) id_candidates[1] else names(dat_master)[2]
}

# Filter blank IDs
dat_master <- dat_master %>%
  mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_master]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_check), str_trim(id_check) != "", str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
  select(-id_check)

# Standardize ID column name
dat_master <- dat_master %>% rename(patient_id = all_of(id_col_master))

# Convert date columns
date_cols_master <- names(dat_master)[str_detect(names(dat_master), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
dat_master <- dat_master %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols_master), as_date_safe))

# Normalize ctDNA column names
names(dat_master) <- str_replace_all(names(dat_master), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")

# Ensure ctDNA numeric columns are numeric
ctdna_value_cols_master <- names(dat_master)[str_detect(names(dat_master), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(ctdna_value_cols_master)) {
  dat_master[ctdna_value_cols_master] <- lapply(dat_master[ctdna_value_cols_master], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
    y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

# Use master dataset as combined (all patients now in Master1)
# Ensure dataset column exists for downstream grouping logic
if ("dataset" %in% names(dat_master)) {
  dat_master <- dat_master %>% mutate(dataset = coalesce(dataset, "Master1"))
} else {
  dat_master <- dat_master %>% mutate(dataset = "Master1")
}
dat_combined <- dat_master

invisible(cat("Total patients loaded from Master1:", nrow(dat_combined), "\n"))
```

```{r extract_patient_characteristics, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Patient Characteristics
# ==============================


# Extract primary tumor location
primary_location_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("primary.*tumor.*location|tumor.*location|primary.*site", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(primary_location_cols) > 0) {
  dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
    mutate(
      primary_site = case_when(
        !is.na(.data[[primary_location_cols[1]]]) ~ as.character(.data[[primary_location_cols[1]]]),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
} else {
  dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
    mutate(primary_site = NA_character_)
}

# Extract histology
histology_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^histology$|histology.*type", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(histology_cols) > 0) {
  dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
    mutate(
      histology_clean = case_when(
        !is.na(.data[[histology_cols[1]]]) ~ as.character(.data[[histology_cols[1]]]),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      histology_clean = str_replace_all(histology_clean, 
                                        regex("urothelial/transitional|transitional/urothelial", ignore_case = TRUE), 
                                        "urothelial")
    )
} else {
  dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
    mutate(histology_clean = NA_character_)
}

# Create patient groups
dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
  mutate(
    primary_site_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "bladder") ~ "Bladder",
      str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "renal.*pelvis|pelvis") ~ "Renal Pelvis",
      str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "ureter") ~ "Ureter",
      dataset == "Lower Tract" ~ "Bladder",  # Default for lower tract
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    is_urothelial = str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "urothelial|transitional"),
    patient_group = case_when(
      primary_site_clean == "Bladder" & is_urothelial ~ "Bladder - Urothelial",
      primary_site_clean == "Renal Pelvis" & is_urothelial ~ "UTUC (Renal Pelvis - Urothelial)",
      primary_site_clean == "Ureter" & is_urothelial ~ "Ureter - Urothelial",
      primary_site_clean == "Bladder" & !is_urothelial ~ "Bladder - Variant Histology",
      primary_site_clean == "Renal Pelvis" & !is_urothelial ~ "Renal Pelvis - Variant Histology",
      primary_site_clean == "Ureter" & !is_urothelial ~ "Ureter - Variant Histology",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

invisible(table(dat_combined$patient_group, useNA = "always"))
invisible(table(dat_combined$primary_site_clean, useNA = "always"))
invisible(table(dat_combined$histology_clean, useNA = "always"))
```

```{r extract_therapy_and_treatment, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Therapy and Treatment Information
# ==============================


# Extract systemic therapy settings
therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*treatment.*setting|systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
  therapy_settings_long <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(patient_id, dataset), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
      setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(setting_clean))
  
  # Summarize per patient
  patient_therapy <- therapy_settings_long %>%
    group_by(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    summarise(
      has_neoadjuvant = any(setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
      has_adjuvant = any(setting_clean == "Adjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
      has_palliative = any(setting_clean == "Palliative", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  patient_therapy <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(
      has_neoadjuvant = FALSE,
      has_adjuvant = FALSE,
      has_palliative = FALSE
    )
}

# Extract surgery information
surgery_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("surgery.*type|surgery.*procedure|surgery_\\d+_type|surgery_\\d+_procedure", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(surgery_cols) > 0) {
  surgery_data <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(surgery_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(patient_id, dataset), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_type") %>%
    mutate(surgery_type_lower = tolower(as.character(surgery_type))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_type), surgery_type != "")
  
  patient_surgery <- surgery_data %>%
    group_by(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    summarise(
      has_cystectomy = any(str_detect(surgery_type_lower, "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy"), na.rm = TRUE),
      has_definitive_surgery = any(!str_detect(surgery_type_lower, "turbt|endoscopic.*resection"), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  # Check for surgery yes/no columns
  surgery_yesno_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("surgery.*yes.*no|cancer.*directed.*surgery", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(surgery_yesno_cols) > 0) {
    patient_surgery <- dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(surgery_yesno_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        has_definitive_surgery = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[surgery_yesno_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ TRUE,
          TRUE ~ FALSE
        ),
        has_cystectomy = has_definitive_surgery  # Assume yes if surgery performed
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, dataset, has_cystectomy, has_definitive_surgery)
  } else {
    patient_surgery <- dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
      mutate(
        has_cystectomy = FALSE,
        has_definitive_surgery = FALSE
      )
  }
}

# Extract radiation information
radiation_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*yes.*no|rt.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(radiation_cols) > 0) {
  patient_radiation <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(radiation_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      has_radiation = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[radiation_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, has_radiation)
} else {
  patient_radiation <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(has_radiation = FALSE)
}

# Extract systemic therapy yes/no
systemic_therapy_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(systemic_therapy_cols) > 0) {
  patient_systemic <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(systemic_therapy_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      has_systemic_therapy = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[systemic_therapy_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, has_systemic_therapy)
} else {
  # Use therapy settings to determine
  patient_systemic <- patient_therapy %>%
    mutate(has_systemic_therapy = has_neoadjuvant | has_adjuvant | has_palliative) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, has_systemic_therapy)
}

# Combine all treatment information
patient_treatment <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, dataset, patient_group, primary_site_clean, histology_clean) %>%
  left_join(patient_therapy, by = c("patient_id", "dataset")) %>%
  left_join(patient_surgery, by = c("patient_id", "dataset")) %>%
  left_join(patient_radiation, by = c("patient_id", "dataset")) %>%
  left_join(patient_systemic, by = c("patient_id", "dataset")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_neoadjuvant = ifelse(is.na(has_neoadjuvant), FALSE, has_neoadjuvant),
    has_adjuvant = ifelse(is.na(has_adjuvant), FALSE, has_adjuvant),
    has_palliative = ifelse(is.na(has_palliative), FALSE, has_palliative),
    has_cystectomy = ifelse(is.na(has_cystectomy), FALSE, has_cystectomy),
    has_definitive_surgery = ifelse(is.na(has_definitive_surgery), FALSE, has_definitive_surgery),
    has_radiation = ifelse(is.na(has_radiation), FALSE, has_radiation),
    has_systemic_therapy = ifelse(is.na(has_systemic_therapy), FALSE, has_systemic_therapy)
  )

invisible(cat("\nTreatment Summary:\n"))
invisible(cat("  Neoadjuvant:", sum(patient_treatment$has_neoadjuvant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"))
invisible(cat("  Adjuvant:", sum(patient_treatment$has_adjuvant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"))
invisible(cat("  Palliative:", sum(patient_treatment$has_palliative, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"))
invisible(cat("  Cystectomy/Definitive Surgery:", sum(patient_treatment$has_definitive_surgery, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"))
invisible(cat("  Radiation:", sum(patient_treatment$has_radiation, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"))
invisible(cat("  Systemic Therapy:", sum(patient_treatment$has_systemic_therapy, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"))
```

```{r extract_staging_and_demographics, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Staging and Demographics
# ==============================


# Extract T stage at diagnosis
t_stage_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("pathology.*t.*stage|t.*stage.*pathology|pathology_t_stage_2|t_stage", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Function to parse T stage
parse_t_stage <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "NA") return(NA_character_)
  x_upper <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  if (str_detect(x_upper, "^T[0-4]")) {
    return(str_extract(x_upper, "^T[0-4][A-Z]?"))
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}

# Extract T stage
if (length(t_stage_cols) > 0) {
  patient_staging <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(t_stage_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      t_stage_raw = as.character(.data[[t_stage_cols[1]]]),
      t_stage_parsed = purrr::map_chr(t_stage_raw, parse_t_stage),
      t2a_or_higher = case_when(
        str_detect(t_stage_parsed, "^T[2-4]") ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, t_stage_parsed, t2a_or_higher)
} else {
  patient_staging <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(
      t_stage_parsed = NA_character_,
      t2a_or_higher = NA
    )
}

# Extract M stage
m_stage_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("pathology.*m.*stage|m.*stage.*pathology|pathology_m_stage|m_stage", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(m_stage_cols) > 0) {
  patient_m_stage <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(m_stage_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      m_stage_raw = as.character(.data[[m_stage_cols[1]]]),
      m1_disease = case_when(
        str_detect(toupper(m_stage_raw), "M1") ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, m1_disease)
} else {
  patient_m_stage <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(m1_disease = NA)
}

# Extract race and ethnicity
race_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("race", ignore_case = TRUE))]
ethnicity_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("ethnicity|ethnic", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(race_cols) > 0) {
  patient_demographics <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(race_cols[1])) %>%
    rename(race = all_of(race_cols[1]))
} else {
  patient_demographics <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(race = NA_character_)
}

if (length(ethnicity_cols) > 0) {
  patient_demographics <- patient_demographics %>%
    left_join(
      dat_combined %>% select(patient_id, all_of(ethnicity_cols[1])) %>% rename(ethnicity = all_of(ethnicity_cols[1])),
      by = "patient_id"
    )
} else {
  patient_demographics <- patient_demographics %>%
    mutate(ethnicity = NA_character_)
}

# Extract overall stage and parse to Stage I, II, III, IV
stage_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cancer.*stage|stage.*cancer|clinical.*stage", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Function to extract stage number (I, II, III, IV)
extract_stage_number <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "NA") return(NA_character_)
  x_upper <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  # Look for Stage I, II, III, IV
  stage_match <- str_extract(x_upper, "STAGE\\s*([IVX]+)")
  if (!is.na(stage_match)) {
    stage_roman <- str_extract(stage_match, "[IVX]+")
    return(stage_roman)
  }
  # Also check for just I, II, III, IV
  if (str_detect(x_upper, "^[IVX]+$")) {
    return(x_upper)
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}

if (length(stage_cols) > 0) {
  patient_stage_overall <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(stage_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      overall_stage_raw = as.character(.data[[stage_cols[1]]]),
      overall_stage = purrr::map_chr(overall_stage_raw, extract_stage_number),
      stage_1 = case_when(overall_stage == "I" ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ FALSE),
      stage_2 = case_when(overall_stage == "II" ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ FALSE),
      stage_3 = case_when(overall_stage == "III" ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ FALSE),
      stage_4 = case_when(overall_stage == "IV" ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ FALSE)
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, overall_stage, stage_1, stage_2, stage_3, stage_4)
} else {
  patient_stage_overall <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(
      overall_stage = NA_character_,
      stage_1 = NA,
      stage_2 = NA,
      stage_3 = NA,
      stage_4 = NA
    )
}
```

```{r create_table1}
# ==============================
# Table 1: Patient Characteristics by Group
# ==============================


# Combine all patient data
table1_data <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, dataset, patient_group, primary_site_clean, histology_clean) %>%
  left_join(patient_treatment, by = c("patient_id", "dataset", "patient_group", "primary_site_clean", "histology_clean")) %>%
  left_join(patient_staging_demo %>% select(patient_id, dataset, t2a_or_higher, race, ethnicity), by = c("patient_id", "dataset")) %>%
  left_join(patient_stage_overall %>% select(patient_id, dataset, stage_1, stage_2, stage_3, stage_4), by = c("patient_id", "dataset")) %>%
  left_join(ctdna_counts, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(n_ctdna = ifelse(is.na(n_ctdna), 0, n_ctdna))

# Create summary by patient group
table1_summary <- table1_data %>%
  group_by(patient_group) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    # ctDNA measurements
    n_ctdna_median = median(n_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ctdna_iqr_low = quantile(n_ctdna, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ctdna_iqr_high = quantile(n_ctdna, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Therapy
    neoadjuvant_n = sum(has_neoadjuvant, na.rm = TRUE),
    neoadjuvant_pct = round(neoadjuvant_n / N * 100, 1),
    adjuvant_n = sum(has_adjuvant, na.rm = TRUE),
    adjuvant_pct = round(adjuvant_n / N * 100, 1),
    palliative_n = sum(has_palliative, na.rm = TRUE),
    palliative_pct = round(palliative_n / N * 100, 1),
    # Treatment
    definitive_surgery_n = sum(has_definitive_surgery, na.rm = TRUE),
    definitive_surgery_pct = round(definitive_surgery_n / N * 100, 1),
    radiation_n = sum(has_radiation, na.rm = TRUE),
    radiation_pct = round(radiation_n / N * 100, 1),
    systemic_therapy_n = sum(has_systemic_therapy, na.rm = TRUE),
    systemic_therapy_pct = round(systemic_therapy_n / N * 100, 1),
    # Staging
    t2a_or_higher_n = sum(t2a_or_higher == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    t2a_or_higher_pct = round(t2a_or_higher_n / N * 100, 1),
    stage_1_n = sum(stage_1 == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    stage_1_pct = round(stage_1_n / N * 100, 1),
    stage_2_n = sum(stage_2 == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    stage_2_pct = round(stage_2_n / N * 100, 1),
    stage_3_n = sum(stage_3 == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    stage_3_pct = round(stage_3_n / N * 100, 1),
    stage_4_n = sum(stage_4 == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    stage_4_pct = round(stage_4_n / N * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_ctdna_summary = paste0(n_ctdna_median, " (", n_ctdna_iqr_low, "-", n_ctdna_iqr_high, ")"),
    neoadjuvant = paste0(neoadjuvant_n, " (", neoadjuvant_pct, "%)"),
    adjuvant = paste0(adjuvant_n, " (", adjuvant_pct, "%)"),
    palliative = paste0(palliative_n, " (", palliative_pct, "%)"),
    definitive_surgery = paste0(definitive_surgery_n, " (", definitive_surgery_pct, "%)"),
    radiation = paste0(radiation_n, " (", radiation_pct, "%)"),
    systemic_therapy = paste0(systemic_therapy_n, " (", systemic_therapy_pct, "%)"),
    t2a_or_higher = paste0(t2a_or_higher_n, " (", t2a_or_higher_pct, "%)"),
    stage_1 = paste0(stage_1_n, " (", stage_1_pct, "%)"),
    stage_2 = paste0(stage_2_n, " (", stage_2_pct, "%)"),
    stage_3 = paste0(stage_3_n, " (", stage_3_pct, "%)"),
    stage_4 = paste0(stage_4_n, " (", stage_4_pct, "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(patient_group, N, n_ctdna_summary, neoadjuvant, adjuvant, palliative, 
         definitive_surgery, radiation, systemic_therapy, t2a_or_higher, 
         stage_1, stage_2, stage_3, stage_4)

# Add race and ethnicity distributions
race_ethnicity_summary <- table1_data %>%
  group_by(patient_group) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    # Race
    race_dist = if (sum(!is.na(race) & race != "" & race != "NA") > 0) {
      race_table <- count(tibble(race = race[!is.na(race) & race != "" & race != "NA"]), race, sort = TRUE)
      paste(paste0(race_table$race, ": ", race_table$n, " (", round(race_table$n / sum(race_table$n) * 100, 1), "%)"), collapse = "; ")
    } else {
      "N/A"
    },
    # Ethnicity
    ethnicity_dist = if (sum(!is.na(ethnicity) & ethnicity != "" & ethnicity != "NA") > 0) {
      ethnicity_table <- count(tibble(ethnicity = ethnicity[!is.na(ethnicity) & ethnicity != "" & ethnicity != "NA"]), ethnicity, sort = TRUE)
      paste(paste0(ethnicity_table$ethnicity, ": ", ethnicity_table$n, " (", round(ethnicity_table$n / sum(ethnicity_table$n) * 100, 1), "%)"), collapse = "; ")
    } else {
      "N/A"
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create formatted table
table1_formatted <- table1_summary %>%
  left_join(race_ethnicity_summary %>% select(patient_group, race_dist, ethnicity_dist), by = "patient_group") %>%
  rename(
    `Patient Group` = patient_group,
    `N` = N,
    `ctDNA Measurements, Median (IQR)` = n_ctdna_summary,
    `Neoadjuvant, n (%)` = neoadjuvant,
    `Adjuvant, n (%)` = adjuvant,
    `Palliative, n (%)` = palliative,
    `Definitive Surgery, n (%)` = definitive_surgery,
    `Radiation, n (%)` = radiation,
    `Systemic Therapy, n (%)` = systemic_therapy,
    `T2a or Higher, n (%)` = t2a_or_higher,
    `Stage I, n (%)` = stage_1,
    `Stage II, n (%)` = stage_2,
    `Stage III, n (%)` = stage_3,
    `Stage IV, n (%)` = stage_4,
    `Race Distribution` = race_dist,
    `Ethnicity Distribution` = ethnicity_dist
  )

kable(table1_formatted, 
      caption = "Table 1: Patient Characteristics by Primary Site and Histology",
      align = "l") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 10) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)

# Also show histology frequencies
histology_freq <- table1_data %>%
  count(histology_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  rename(Histology = histology_clean, `N` = n)

kable(histology_freq, caption = "Histology Distribution") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

# Show primary site distribution
primary_site_freq <- table1_data %>%
  count(primary_site_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  rename(`Primary Site` = primary_site_clean, `N` = n)

kable(primary_site_freq, caption = "Primary Site Distribution") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r extract_survival_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Survival Data
# ==============================


# Function to extract survival data from a dataset
extract_survival_data <- function(dat, id_col_name, raw_data = NULL, row_num = NULL) {
  # Get relapse date
  relapse_date <- NULL
  relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(relapse_cols) > 0) {
    relapse_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(relapse_date_raw = all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), relapse_date)
    relapse_date <- relapse_data
  }
  
  # Get explicit death date
  explicit_death_date <- NULL
  death_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                 !str_detect(names(dat), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
    death_date_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(death_date_raw = all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        explicit_death_date = if (inherits(death_date_raw, "Date")) {
          death_date_raw
        } else {
          as_date_safe(death_date_raw)
        }
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), explicit_death_date)
    explicit_death_date <- death_date_data
  }
  
  # Get survival/follow-up date
  survival_date <- NULL
  survival_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                              !str_detect(names(dat), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
    survival_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(survival_date_raw = all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(survival_date = as_date_safe(survival_date_raw)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), survival_date)
    survival_date <- survival_data
  }
  
  # Get alive yes/no status
  alive_status <- NULL
  alive_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
    alive_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(alive_status_raw = all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        alive_yes_no = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), alive_yes_no)
    alive_status <- alive_data
  }
  
  # Get death status (legacy)
  death_status <- NULL
  death_status_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("death|died|vital.*status", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                   !str_detect(names(dat), regex("date|alive", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(death_status_cols) > 0) {
    death_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(death_status_raw = all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        death_status_legacy = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(death_status_raw)), "yes|dead|died|death|deceased") ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), death_status_legacy)
    death_status <- death_data
  }
  
  # Extract palliative therapy start dates
  palliative_dates <- NULL
  therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  therapy_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
    therapy_settings_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "setting") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
        setting_lower = tolower(as.character(setting))
      ) %>%
      filter(str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative"))
    
    therapy_starts_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
        start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date))
    
    palliative_dates <- therapy_settings_long %>%
      left_join(therapy_starts_long, by = c(id_col_name, "therapy_idx")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
      summarise(
        first_palliative_date = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      rename(palliative_start_date = first_palliative_date)
  }
  
  # Combine
  result <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col_name))
  if (!is.null(relapse_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(relapse_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(relapse_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(explicit_death_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(explicit_death_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(explicit_death_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(survival_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(survival_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(survival_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(alive_status)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(alive_status, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(alive_yes_no = NA_character_)
  }
  if (!is.null(death_status)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(death_status, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(death_status_legacy = NA_real_)
  }
  if (!is.null(palliative_dates)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(palliative_dates, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(palliative_start_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  
  result
}

# Extract survival data from both datasets
survival_data <- extract_survival_data(dat_master, "patient_id", raw_master, row_num = 259)
```

```{r create_survival_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create Survival Outcomes
# ==============================


# Get baseline ctDNA
baseline_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, baseline_date = ctdna_date, baseline_value = ctdna_value)

# Get last ctDNA and therapy dates
last_ctdna_dates <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Extract last therapy dates
extract_last_therapy_date <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
  therapy_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*(start|end).*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(therapy_cols) > 0) {
    therapy_dates_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "therapy_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(therapy_date = as_date_safe(therapy_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_date)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
      summarise(last_therapy_date = max(therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    return(therapy_dates_long)
  } else {
    return(tibble(!!id_col_name := dat[[id_col_name]], last_therapy_date = as.Date(NA)))
  }
}

last_therapy_dates <- extract_last_therapy_date(dat_master, "patient_id") %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(last_therapy_date = max(last_therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(last_therapy_date = ifelse(is.infinite(last_therapy_date), as.Date(NA), last_therapy_date))

# Create survival outcomes
all_patients <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
  distinct()

survival_outcomes <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(last_ctdna_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(last_therapy_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(survival_data, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, survival_date),
    relapse_date_combined = case_when(
      !is.na(relapse_date) & !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ pmin(relapse_date, palliative_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      !is.na(relapse_date) ~ relapse_date,
      !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ palliative_start_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    death_status_final = case_when(
      !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ 1,
      alive_yes_no == "No" ~ 1,
      !is.na(death_status_legacy) & death_status_legacy == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    death_date = case_when(
      !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ explicit_death_date,
      alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
      alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(relapse_date_combined) ~ relapse_date_combined,
      death_status_legacy == 1 & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    max_ctdna_therapy_date = {
      result <- rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(.))
      for (i in 1:nrow(.)) {
        if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date[i]) && !is.na(last_therapy_date[i])) {
          result[i] <- pmax(last_ctdna_date[i], last_therapy_date[i])
        } else if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date[i])) {
          result[i] <- last_ctdna_date[i]
        } else if (!is.na(last_therapy_date[i])) {
          result[i] <- last_therapy_date[i]
        }
      }
      result
    },
    last_available_date = case_when(
      !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,
      !is.na(max_ctdna_therapy_date) ~ max_ctdna_therapy_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_relapse = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                            as.numeric(relapse_date_combined - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
    time_to_death = ifelse(!is.na(death_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                          as.numeric(death_date - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
    time_to_last_fu = ifelse(!is.na(last_available_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                             as.numeric(last_available_date - time_anchor) / 30.44, NA_real_),
    relapse_event = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined), 1, 0),
    death_event = death_status_final,
    pfs_time = ifelse(relapse_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_relapse), time_to_relapse, 
                     ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)),
    os_time = ifelse(
      death_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_death), 
      time_to_death,
      ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)
    )
  )

invisible(cat("Survival outcomes created for", nrow(survival_outcomes), "patients\n"))
```

```{r create_qualitative_quantitative_groups, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create Qualitative and Quantitative Groups
# NOTE: This section has been moved to ctDNA_QQ_ML_Thresholds_Comparison.Rmd
# ==============================


# Qualitative groups
qualitative_groups <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(
    ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
      arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      mutate(
        baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
        baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
        days_from_baseline = as.numeric(ctdna_date - baseline_date),
        # Check if measurement is after baseline
        is_after_baseline = days_from_baseline > 0
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        baseline_status = ifelse(first(baseline_value) > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
        # Check if became negative AFTER baseline (for clearance)
        became_negative_after = any(is_after_baseline & baseline_value > 0 & ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        # Check if became positive AFTER baseline (for conversion) - aligns with Quantitative "New Positive"
        became_positive_after = any(is_after_baseline & baseline_value == 0 & ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        last_status = ifelse(last(ctdna_value) > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        qualitative_group = case_when(
          # ctDNA Clearance: started positive, became negative after baseline
          baseline_status == "Positive" & became_negative_after ~ "ctDNA Clearance",
          # Persistent Negative: baseline negative and never became positive after baseline
          baseline_status == "Negative" & !became_positive_after ~ "Persistent Negative",
          # Persistent Positive: baseline positive and never became negative after baseline
          baseline_status == "Positive" & !became_negative_after ~ "Persistent Positive",
          # ctDNA Conversion: baseline negative and became positive after baseline
          # This now aligns with Quantitative "New Positive" - baseline 0 and any measurement > 0 after baseline
          baseline_status == "Negative" & became_positive_after ~ "ctDNA Conversion",
          TRUE ~ "No ctDNA Data"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, qualitative_group),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(qualitative_group = ifelse(is.na(qualitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", qualitative_group))

# Quantitative groups - need response_data
response_data_quant <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date, baseline_value), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    days_from_baseline = as.numeric(ctdna_date - baseline_date),
    percent_change = case_when(
      baseline_value == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      baseline_value > 0 ~ ((ctdna_value - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(days_from_baseline > 0) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date)

quantitative_groups <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(
    response_data_quant %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(
        baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
        best_reduction_pct = min(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
        worst_increase_pct = max(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_value = max(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        quantitative_group = case_when(
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(best_reduction_pct) & best_reduction_pct <= -90 ~ "Major Response (≥90% reduction)",
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(best_reduction_pct) & best_reduction_pct <= -50 & best_reduction_pct > -90 ~ "Partial Response (≥50% reduction)",
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(worst_increase_pct) & worst_increase_pct >= 50 ~ "Progressive (≥50% increase)",
          baseline_value > 0 ~ "Stable (<50% change)",
          baseline_value == 0 & max_value > 0 ~ "New Positive",
          baseline_value == 0 & max_value == 0 ~ "Persistent Negative",
          TRUE ~ "No ctDNA Data"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, quantitative_group),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(quantitative_group = ifelse(is.na(quantitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", quantitative_group))

invisible(cat("Qualitative groups created\n"))
invisible(cat("Quantitative groups created\n"))

# Create ML groups (simplified version from ctDNA_Response.Rmd)

# Prepare features for ML
ctdna_with_trend <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_value, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    time_from_first = as.numeric(ctdna_date - min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    row_num = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

calculate_trend <- function(values, times) {
  valid <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(times)
  if (sum(valid) > 1) {
    tryCatch({
      lm_fit <- lm(values[valid] ~ times[valid])
      as.numeric(coef(lm_fit)[2])
    }, error = function(e) 0)
  } else {
    0
  }
}

trend_data <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, sum(!is.na(ctdna_value)) > 1, sum(!is.na(time_from_first)) > 1) %>%
  summarise(trend = calculate_trend(ctdna_value, time_from_first), .groups = "drop")

patients_no_trend <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n == 1 | !patient_id %in% trend_data$patient_id) %>%
  mutate(trend = 0) %>%
  select(patient_id, trend)

trend_all <- bind_rows(trend_data, patients_no_trend)

ml_features <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
    n_measurements = n(),
    mean_ctdna = mean(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ctdna = median(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ctdna = max(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ctdna = min(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ctdna = sd(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_positive = sum(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative = sum(ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    became_negative = any(baseline_value > 0 & ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    became_positive = any(baseline_value == 0 & ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_value = last(ctdna_value),
    first_value = first(ctdna_value),
    pct_change_baseline = ifelse(baseline_value > 0, 
                                 ((last(ctdna_value) - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100,
                                 ifelse(baseline_value == 0 & last(ctdna_value) > 0, 100, 0)),
    time_span_days = as.numeric(max(ctdna_date) - min(ctdna_date)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(trend_all, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    cv_ctdna = ifelse(mean_ctdna > 0 & !is.na(sd_ctdna), sd_ctdna / mean_ctdna, 0),
    trend_per_day = ifelse(!is.na(time_span_days) & time_span_days > 0, trend / time_span_days, 0),
    clearance_pattern = became_negative & baseline_value > 0,
    conversion_pattern = became_positive & baseline_value == 0,
    persistent_positive = baseline_value > 0 & !became_negative & last_value > 0,
    persistent_negative = baseline_value == 0 & !became_positive & last_value == 0,
    across(c(mean_ctdna, median_ctdna, max_ctdna, min_ctdna, sd_ctdna, trend, cv_ctdna, 
             trend_per_day, pct_change_baseline, time_span_days),
           ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))
  )

# Split data (60/20/20)
set.seed(123)
n_patients_ml <- nrow(ml_features)
train_idx <- sample(n_patients_ml, size = floor(0.6 * n_patients_ml))
remaining_idx <- setdiff(1:n_patients_ml, train_idx)
validation_idx <- sample(remaining_idx, size = floor(0.5 * length(remaining_idx)))
test_idx <- setdiff(remaining_idx, validation_idx)

ml_features_train <- ml_features[train_idx, ]
ml_features_validation <- ml_features[validation_idx, ]
ml_features_test <- ml_features[test_idx, ]

# Select features for clustering
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(ml_features), c("patient_id", "baseline_value"))
ml_features_train_for_clustering <- ml_features_train %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

ml_features_train_scaled <- scale(ml_features_train_for_clustering)
ml_features_train_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_train_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_train_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_train_scaled)] <- 0

scale_center <- attr(ml_features_train_scaled, "scaled:center")
scale_scale <- attr(ml_features_train_scaled, "scaled:scale")

n_train <- nrow(ml_features_train_scaled)
n_clusters <- if (n_train >= 6) 5 else if (n_train >= 4) 4 else max(2, n_train)

kmeans_result_train <- kmeans(ml_features_train_scaled, centers = n_clusters, nstart = 50, iter.max = 200)
cluster_centers <- kmeans_result_train$centers

assign_to_cluster <- function(features_scaled, centers) {
  distances <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(features_scaled), ncol = nrow(centers))
  for (i in 1:nrow(features_scaled)) {
    for (j in 1:nrow(centers)) {
      distances[i, j] <- sum((features_scaled[i, ] - centers[j, ])^2)
    }
  }
  apply(distances, 1, which.min)
}

ml_features_validation_for_clustering <- ml_features_validation %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

ml_features_test_for_clustering <- ml_features_test %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

ml_features_validation_scaled <- scale(ml_features_validation_for_clustering, 
                                        center = scale_center, scale = scale_scale)
ml_features_test_scaled <- scale(ml_features_test_for_clustering, 
                                 center = scale_center, scale = scale_scale)

ml_features_validation_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_validation_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_validation_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_validation_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_test_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_test_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_test_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_test_scaled)] <- 0

validation_clusters <- assign_to_cluster(ml_features_validation_scaled, cluster_centers)
test_clusters <- assign_to_cluster(ml_features_test_scaled, cluster_centers)

cluster_characteristics <- ml_features_train %>%
  mutate(ml_cluster = kmeans_result_train$cluster) %>%
  group_by(ml_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_baseline = mean(baseline_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_clearance = mean(clearance_pattern, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_conversion = mean(conversion_pattern, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_persistent_pos = mean(persistent_positive, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_persistent_neg = mean(persistent_negative, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_baseline, mean_trend)

cluster_names <- cluster_characteristics %>%
  mutate(
    group_name = case_when(
      pct_clearance >= 50 & mean_trend < 0 ~ "Clearance/Response (Positive→Negative)",
      pct_conversion >= 50 & mean_trend > 0 ~ "Conversion/Progression (Negative→Positive)",
      mean_baseline > 5 & pct_persistent_pos >= 50 & mean_trend >= 0 ~ "Persistent High ctDNA (Stable/Increasing)",
      mean_baseline <= 1 & pct_persistent_neg >= 50 ~ "Persistent Low/Negative ctDNA",
      TRUE ~ paste0("Group ", ml_cluster, ": Mixed Pattern")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(ml_cluster, group_name)

ml_features_all <- ml_features %>%
  mutate(
    ml_cluster = case_when(
      patient_id %in% ml_features_train$patient_id ~ kmeans_result_train$cluster[match(patient_id, ml_features_train$patient_id)],
      patient_id %in% ml_features_validation$patient_id ~ validation_clusters[match(patient_id, ml_features_validation$patient_id)],
      patient_id %in% ml_features_test$patient_id ~ test_clusters[match(patient_id, ml_features_test$patient_id)],
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

ml_groups <- ml_features_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(ml_cluster)) %>%
  left_join(cluster_names, by = "ml_cluster") %>%
  select(patient_id, ml_group = group_name, ml_cluster)

invisible(cat("ML groups created\n"))
```

```{r create_table2, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Table 2: Survival Outcomes by Qualitative and Quantitative Groups
# NOTE: This section has been moved to ctDNA_QQ_ML_Thresholds_Comparison.Rmd
# ==============================


# Function to calculate C-index and AIC
calculate_c_index <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_))
  }
  
  surv_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  cox_fit <- tryCatch({
    coxph(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit)) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_))
  }
  
  c_index <- tryCatch({
    summary(cox_fit)$concordance[1]
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  aic_value <- tryCatch({
    AIC(cox_fit)
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  return(list(c_index = c_index, aic = aic_value))
}

# Merge survival with groups
survival_qualitative <- survival_outcomes %>%
  left_join(qualitative_groups %>% select(patient_id, qualitative_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(qualitative_group = ifelse(is.na(qualitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", qualitative_group))

survival_quantitative <- survival_outcomes %>%
  left_join(quantitative_groups %>% select(patient_id, quantitative_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(quantitative_group = ifelse(is.na(quantitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", quantitative_group))

# Function to calculate survival medians for a group
calculate_survival_medians <- function(data, time_var, event_var) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), .data[[time_var]] > 0)
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(median = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_))
  }
  
  surv_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ 1"))
  fit <- tryCatch({
    survfit(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(list(median = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_))
  }
  
  median_quantile <- tryCatch({
    quantile(fit, 0.5)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(median_quantile)) {
    return(list(median = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_))
  }
  
  return(list(
    median = median_quantile$quantile,
    ci_lower = median_quantile$lower,
    ci_upper = median_quantile$upper
  ))
}

# Calculate survival statistics for qualitative groups

    pfs_median = map_dbl(qualitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(qual_pfs_results)) qual_pfs_results[[.x]]$median else NA_real_),

    pfs_ci_upper = map_dbl(qualitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(qual_pfs_results)) qual_pfs_results[[.x]]$ci_upper else NA_real_)

# Calculate survival statistics for quantitative groups

# Calculate medians for each group - use a simpler approach
quantitative_survival_list <- survival_quantitative %>%

quant_os_results <- map(quantitative_survival_list, ~calculate_survival_medians(.x, "os_time", "death_event"))
quant_pfs_results <- map(quantitative_survival_list, ~calculate_survival_medians(.x, "pfs_time", "relapse_event"))

# Add medians to summary
quantitative_survival <- quantitative_survival %>%

    os_median = map_dbl(quantitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(quant_os_results)) quant_os_results[[.x]]$median else NA_real_),
    os_ci_lower = map_dbl(quantitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(quant_os_results)) quant_os_results[[.x]]$ci_lower else NA_real_),
    os_ci_upper = map_dbl(quantitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(quant_os_results)) quant_os_results[[.x]]$ci_upper else NA_real_),
    pfs_median = map_dbl(quantitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(quant_pfs_results)) quant_pfs_results[[.x]]$median else NA_real_),
    pfs_ci_lower = map_dbl(quantitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(quant_pfs_results)) quant_pfs_results[[.x]]$ci_lower else NA_real_),
    pfs_ci_upper = map_dbl(quantitative_group, ~if(.x %in% names(quant_pfs_results)) quant_pfs_results[[.x]]$ci_upper else NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    os_summary = ifelse(!is.na(os_median), 
                       paste0(round(os_median, 1), " (", round(os_ci_lower, 1), "-", round(os_ci_upper, 1), ")"),

    pfs_summary = ifelse(!is.na(pfs_median),
                        paste0(round(pfs_median, 1), " (", round(pfs_ci_lower, 1), "-", round(pfs_ci_upper, 1), ")"),

  )

# Calculate C-index and AIC for quantitative
quant_c_index_os <- calculate_c_index(survival_quantitative, "os_time", "death_event", "quantitative_group")
quant_c_index_pfs <- calculate_c_index(survival_quantitative, "pfs_time", "relapse_event", "quantitative_group")

quantitative_survival <- quantitative_survival %>%

# Create simplified Table 2 (just group names and N)
```

```{r create_cindex_aic_table, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create C-Index and AIC Comparison Table
# NOTE: This section has been moved to ctDNA_QQ_ML_Thresholds_Comparison.Rmd
# ==============================


# Function to calculate C-index with 95% CI using bootstrap
calculate_c_index_with_ci <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var, n_bootstrap = 1000) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_, n = 0))
  }
  
  surv_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  cox_fit <- tryCatch({
    coxph(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit)) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_, n = nrow(data_clean)))
  }
  
  c_index <- tryCatch({
    summary(cox_fit)$concordance[1]
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  aic_value <- tryCatch({
    AIC(cox_fit)
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  # Bootstrap for 95% CI
  set.seed(123)
  n <- nrow(data_clean)
  c_index_bootstrap <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    boot_idx <- sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    data_boot <- data_clean[boot_idx, ]
    
    cox_fit_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_fit_boot)) {
      c_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      if (!is.na(c_boot)) {
        c_index_bootstrap[i] <- c_boot
      }
    }
  }
  
  ci_lower <- quantile(c_index_bootstrap[c_index_bootstrap > 0], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  ci_upper <- quantile(c_index_bootstrap[c_index_bootstrap > 0], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.na(ci_lower)) ci_lower <- NA_real_
  if (is.na(ci_upper)) ci_upper <- NA_real_
  
  return(list(c_index = c_index, ci_lower = ci_lower, ci_upper = ci_upper, aic = aic_value, n = nrow(data_clean)))
}

# Function to compare C-indices between two models using bootstrap
compare_c_indices <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var1, group_var2, n_bootstrap = 1000) {
  data_clean1 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var1]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var1]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  data_clean2 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var2]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var2]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  common_patients <- intersect(data_clean1$patient_id, data_clean2$patient_id)
  
  if (length(common_patients) < 10) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = length(common_patients)))
  }
  
  data_common <- data %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% common_patients) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0,
           !is.na(.data[[group_var1]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var2]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var1]]), "no ctdna data"),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var2]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_common) == 0 || sum(data_common[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = 0))
  }
  
  surv_formula1 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var1))
  surv_formula2 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var2))
  
  cox_fit1 <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data_common), error = function(e) NULL)
  cox_fit2 <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data_common), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit1) || is.null(cox_fit2)) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = nrow(data_common)))
  }
  
  c_index1 <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit1)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  c_index2 <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit2)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  if (is.na(c_index1) || is.na(c_index2)) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, diff_ci_lower = NA_real_, diff_ci_upper = NA_real_, n_common = nrow(data_common)))
  }
  
  diff_observed <- c_index1 - c_index2
  
  # Bootstrap to get p-value and CI
  set.seed(123)
  n <- nrow(data_common)
  diff_bootstrap <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    boot_idx <- sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    data_boot <- data_common[boot_idx, ]
    
    cox_fit1_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    cox_fit2_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_fit1_boot) && !is.null(cox_fit2_boot)) {
      c1_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit1_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      c2_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit2_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      
      if (!is.na(c1_boot) && !is.na(c2_boot)) {
        diff_bootstrap[i] <- c1_boot - c2_boot
      }
    }
  }
  
  p_value <- mean(abs(diff_bootstrap) >= abs(diff_observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  diff_ci_lower <- quantile(diff_bootstrap[diff_bootstrap != 0], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  diff_ci_upper <- quantile(diff_bootstrap[diff_bootstrap != 0], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.na(diff_ci_lower)) diff_ci_lower <- NA_real_
  if (is.na(diff_ci_upper)) diff_ci_upper <- NA_real_
  
  return(list(
    p_value = p_value,
    diff_c_index = diff_observed,
    diff_ci_lower = diff_ci_lower,
    diff_ci_upper = diff_ci_upper,
    c_index1 = c_index1,
    c_index2 = c_index2,
    n_common = nrow(data_common),
    n_bootstrap = sum(!is.na(diff_bootstrap))
  ))
}

# Merge survival with ML groups
survival_ml <- survival_outcomes %>%
  left_join(ml_groups %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(ml_group = ifelse(is.na(ml_group), "No ctDNA Data", ml_group))

# Calculate C-index and AIC for all three approaches (OS only)
qual_os_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(survival_qualitative, "os_time", "death_event", "qualitative_group")
quant_os_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(survival_quantitative, "os_time", "death_event", "quantitative_group")
ml_os_results <- calculate_c_index_with_ci(survival_ml, "os_time", "death_event", "ml_group")

# Create comparison table
cindex_aic_table <- tibble(
  Approach = c("Qualitative", "Quantitative", "ML"),
  `OS C-Index (95% CI)` = c(
    ifelse(!is.na(qual_os_results$c_index), 
           paste0(round(qual_os_results$c_index, 3), " (", 
                  round(qual_os_results$ci_lower, 3), "-", 
                  round(qual_os_results$ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(quant_os_results$c_index), 
           paste0(round(quant_os_results$c_index, 3), " (", 
                  round(quant_os_results$ci_lower, 3), "-", 
                  round(quant_os_results$ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(ml_os_results$c_index), 
           paste0(round(ml_os_results$c_index, 3), " (", 
                  round(ml_os_results$ci_lower, 3), "-", 
                  round(ml_os_results$ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A")
  ),
  `OS AIC` = c(
    ifelse(!is.na(qual_os_results$aic), round(qual_os_results$aic, 1), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(quant_os_results$aic), round(quant_os_results$aic, 1), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(ml_os_results$aic), round(ml_os_results$aic, 1), "N/A")
  ),
  `OS N` = c(qual_os_results$n, quant_os_results$n, ml_os_results$n)
)

# Compare Quantitative vs Qualitative and ML
comp_quant_vs_qual <- compare_c_indices(
  survival_quantitative %>% 
    left_join(survival_qualitative %>% select(patient_id, qualitative_group), by = "patient_id"),
  "os_time", "death_event", 
  "quantitative_group", "qualitative_group", n_bootstrap = 1000
)

comp_quant_vs_ml <- compare_c_indices(
  survival_quantitative %>% 
    left_join(survival_ml %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
  "os_time", "death_event", 
  "quantitative_group", "ml_group", n_bootstrap = 1000
)

comp_qual_vs_ml <- compare_c_indices(
  survival_qualitative %>% 
    left_join(survival_ml %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id"),
  "os_time", "death_event", 
  "qualitative_group", "ml_group", n_bootstrap = 1000
)

# Create comparison table
cindex_comparison_table <- tibble(
  Comparison = c("Quantitative vs Qualitative", "Quantitative vs ML", "Qualitative vs ML"),
  `Difference in C-Index (95% CI)` = c(
    ifelse(!is.na(comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_c_index),
           paste0(round(comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_c_index, 3), " (",
                  round(comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_ci_lower, 3), "-",
                  round(comp_quant_vs_qual$diff_ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_c_index),
           paste0(round(comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_c_index, 3), " (",
                  round(comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_ci_lower, 3), "-",
                  round(comp_quant_vs_ml$diff_ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_c_index),
           paste0(round(comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_c_index, 3), " (",
                  round(comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_ci_lower, 3), "-",
                  round(comp_qual_vs_ml$diff_ci_upper, 3), ")"), "N/A")
  ),
  `P-Value` = c(
    ifelse(!is.na(comp_quant_vs_qual$p_value), round(comp_quant_vs_qual$p_value, 4), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(comp_quant_vs_ml$p_value), round(comp_quant_vs_ml$p_value, 4), "N/A"),
    ifelse(!is.na(comp_qual_vs_ml$p_value), round(comp_qual_vs_ml$p_value, 4), "N/A")
  ),
  `N (Common Patients)` = c(
    comp_quant_vs_qual$n_common,
    comp_quant_vs_ml$n_common,
    comp_qual_vs_ml$n_common
  )
)

invisible(cat("C-index and AIC comparison tables created\n"))
```
