```{r figure1_lower_tract_swimmer, fig.width=18, fig.height=14, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Figure 1: ctDNA dynamics of lower tract urothelial carcinoma patients receiving systemic therapy"}
# ==============================
# Figure 1: Lower Tract Swimmer Plot
# Title: ctDNA dynamics of lower tract urothelial carcinoma patients receiving systemic therapy
# Patient Cohort: Patients receiving systemic therapy (bladder urothelial only)
# Time Anchor (X-axis): First known event/follow-up start
# ==============================


# Load patchwork
if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("patchwork", quiet = TRUE)
}
library(patchwork)

# Load lower tract data
file_path_lower_fig <- "Natera_Sheet_Master1.xlsx"
available_sheets_lower_fig <- excel_sheets(file_path_lower_fig)
sheet_name_lower_fig <- if ("Master_Sheet" %in% available_sheets_lower_fig) {
  "Master_Sheet"
} else if ("Sheet1" %in% available_sheets_lower_fig) {
  "Sheet1"
} else {
  available_sheets_lower_fig[1]
}
raw_lower_fig <- read_excel(file_path_lower_fig, sheet = sheet_name_lower_fig, col_names = FALSE)
var_names_lower_fig <- raw_lower_fig[[1]]
dat_lower_fig <- as.data.frame(t(raw_lower_fig[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(dat_lower_fig) <- make.unique(var_names_lower_fig, sep = "_")
dat_lower_fig <- clean_names(dat_lower_fig)

# Identify patient ID column
id_col_lower_fig <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat_lower_fig)) {
  "record_id_linking_key"
} else {
  id_candidates <- names(dat_lower_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_lower_fig), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(id_candidates) > 0) id_candidates[1] else names(dat_lower_fig)[2]
}

# Filter blank IDs and rename to patient_id
dat_lower_fig <- dat_lower_fig %>%
  mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_lower_fig]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_check), str_trim(id_check) != "", str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
  select(-id_check) %>%
  rename(patient_id = all_of(id_col_lower_fig))

# Filter to only bladder urothelial patients (exclude upper tract/renal pelvis)
# Check if primary_tumor_location column exists
if ("primary_tumor_location" %in% names(dat_lower_fig)) {
  dat_lower_fig <- dat_lower_fig %>%
    filter(is.na(primary_tumor_location) | 
           str_detect(tolower(primary_tumor_location), "bladder|lower") |
           !str_detect(tolower(primary_tumor_location), "renal|pelvis|upper|utuc"))
}

# Convert dates
date_cols_lower_fig <- names(dat_lower_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_lower_fig), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
dat_lower_fig <- dat_lower_fig %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols_lower_fig), as_date_safe))

# Normalize ctDNA columns
names(dat_lower_fig) <- str_replace_all(names(dat_lower_fig), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")

ctdna_value_cols_lower_fig <- names(dat_lower_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_lower_fig), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(ctdna_value_cols_lower_fig)) {
  dat_lower_fig[ctdna_value_cols_lower_fig] <- lapply(dat_lower_fig[ctdna_value_cols_lower_fig], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
    y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

# Build ctDNA long
ctdna_long_lower_fig <- build_ctdna_long(dat_lower_fig, "patient_id")

# Use patient_id as id_col for the rest of the code
id_col <- "patient_id"
dat <- dat_lower_fig
ctdna_long <- ctdna_long_lower_fig

# Now proceed with lower tract swimmer plot code
# Filter to patients receiving systemic therapy (on-treatment)
therapy_long <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_raw) & str_squish(regimen_raw) != "")

on_treatment_patients <- therapy_long %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col]])

invisible(cat("Patients receiving systemic therapy (on-treatment):", nrow(on_treatment_patients), "\n"))

# Get first and last ctDNA dates per patient
ctdna_timeline <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(on_treatment_patients, by = id_col) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get last follow-up date (time anchor for x-axis)
follow_up_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(follow_up_cols) == 0) {
  # Try alternative patterns
  follow_up_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("follow.*up", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                str_detect(names(dat), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
}

if (length(follow_up_cols) > 0) {
  follow_up_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(follow_up_date = as_date_safe(follow_up_date))
} else {
  # Use last ctDNA date as proxy if no follow-up date column
  follow_up_dates <- ctdna_timeline %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = last_ctdna_date)
  invisible(cat("Note: Using last ctDNA date as follow-up date proxy\n"))
}

# Build therapy start/end data (needed before calculating first_therapy_start)
therapy_start_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_start_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw))

# Get first therapy start date per patient
first_therapy_start <- therapy_start_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(first_therapy_start = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Get first cystectomy date per patient (to include in anchor calculation)
# Only include cystectomies, exclude TURBT/endoscopic
first_surgery_date <- NULL
surgery_date_cols_temp <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_type_cols_temp <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*type|surgery.*procedure|surgery_\\d+_type|surgery_\\d+_procedure", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(surgery_date_cols_temp) > 0) {
  surgery_data_temp <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_date_cols_temp)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
      surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_var, "\\d+")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date))
  
  # If surgery type columns exist, join them to filter cystectomies
  if (length(surgery_type_cols_temp) > 0) {
    surgery_types_temp <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_type_cols_temp)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_type_var", values_to = "surgery_type_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        surgery_type = as.character(surgery_type_raw),
        surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_type_var, "\\d+")
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_type))
    
    surgery_data_temp <- surgery_data_temp %>%
      left_join(surgery_types_temp %>% select(all_of(id_col), surgery_idx, surgery_type), 
                by = c(id_col, "surgery_idx"))
  } else {
    surgery_data_temp <- surgery_data_temp %>%
      mutate(surgery_type = NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Filter to only cystectomies
  first_surgery_date <- surgery_data_temp %>%
    mutate(
      is_cystectomy = case_when(
        !is.na(surgery_type) ~ str_detect(tolower(surgery_type), "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy"),
        surgery_var == "surgery_1_date" ~ TRUE,  # Assume surgery_1_date is cystectomy if no type column
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is_cystectomy) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
    summarise(first_surgery_date = min(surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Combine patient timeline info and calculate first known event
patient_timeline <- ctdna_timeline %>%
  left_join(follow_up_dates, by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(first_therapy_start, by = id_col) %>%
  {if (!is.null(first_surgery_date)) {
    left_join(., first_surgery_date, by = id_col)
  } else {
    mutate(., first_surgery_date = as.Date(NA))
  }} %>%
  mutate(
    # First known event = minimum of: first ctDNA, first therapy start, first surgery, follow-up start
    first_known_event = pmin(
      first_ctdna_date,
      first_therapy_start,
      first_surgery_date,
      follow_up_date,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    # Use follow-up date or last ctDNA date as end anchor
    time_anchor = coalesce(follow_up_date, last_ctdna_date),
    # Per-patient bar: time from first known event to last follow-up
    follow_up_interval_days = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event),
    follow_up_interval_months = follow_up_interval_days / 30.44
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_known_event), !is.na(time_anchor))

# Get all ctDNA data for on-treatment patients (anchored to first known event)
on_treatment_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), time_anchor, first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    # Time from first known event (anchor = 0)
    months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    ctdna_status = case_when(
      ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
      ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Build therapy end data (start dates already defined above)
therapy_end_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_end_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "end_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(end_date = as_date_safe(end_date_raw))

therapy_settings <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_treatment_setting$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var)

# Combine therapy information
therapy_complete <- therapy_long %>%
  left_join(therapy_start_dates %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, start_date), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_end_dates %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, end_date), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_settings %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, setting_raw), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_clean = clean_regimen(regimen_raw),
    setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw),
    therapy_type = categorize_therapy_type(regimen_raw)
  )

# Get therapy periods relative to first known event
therapy_periods <- therapy_complete %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event, time_anchor), by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    start_months = as.numeric(start_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    end_months = case_when(
      !is.na(end_date) ~ as.numeric(end_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Clean setting for labeling
    setting_label = case_when(
      setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
      is.na(setting_clean) | setting_clean == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
      TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), start_months, end_months, therapy_type, regimen_clean, setting_clean, setting_label)

# Get cystectomy dates (relative to first known event)
# Only include cystectomies (robotic, open), exclude TURBT/endoscopic resection
surgery_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_type_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*type|surgery.*procedure|surgery_\\d+_type|surgery_\\d+_procedure", ignore_case = TRUE))]

surgery_dates <- NULL
if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
  # Get surgery dates and types
  surgery_data <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
      surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_var, "\\d+")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date))
  
  # If surgery type columns exist, join them
  if (length(surgery_type_cols) > 0) {
    surgery_types <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_type_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_type_var", values_to = "surgery_type_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        surgery_type = as.character(surgery_type_raw),
        surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_type_var, "\\d+")
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_type))
    
    surgery_data <- surgery_data %>%
      left_join(surgery_types %>% select(all_of(id_col), surgery_idx, surgery_type), 
                by = c(id_col, "surgery_idx"))
  } else {
    surgery_data <- surgery_data %>%
      mutate(surgery_type = NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Filter to only cystectomies (robotic or open), exclude TURBT/endoscopic
  surgery_data <- surgery_data %>%
    mutate(
      is_cystectomy = case_when(
        !is.na(surgery_type) ~ str_detect(tolower(surgery_type), "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy"),
        surgery_var == "surgery_1_date" ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is_cystectomy)
  
  surgery_dates <- surgery_data %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(surgery_months = as.numeric(surgery_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), surgery_date, surgery_months)
  
}

# Get radiation dates (relative to first known event)
rad_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^(radiation|rt).*?(start|date_start|start_date)$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
radiation_dates <- NULL
if (length(rad_start_cols) > 0) {
  radiation_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(rad_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "rad_var", values_to = "rad_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(rad_date = as_date_safe(rad_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rad_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(rad_months = as.numeric(rad_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), rad_date, rad_months)
}

# Get metastatic relapse dates (relative to first known event)
metastatic_relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
metastatic_relapse_dates <- NULL
if (length(metastatic_relapse_cols) > 0) {
  metastatic_relapse_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(metastatic_relapse_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "relapse_var", values_to = "relapse_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(relapse_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(relapse_months = as.numeric(relapse_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), relapse_date, relapse_months)
} else {
  invisible(cat("Note: Metastatic relapse date columns not found\n"))
}

# Fallback: if no relapse dates captured, use start of first palliative therapy as relapse proxy
if ((is.null(metastatic_relapse_dates) || nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates) == 0) && exists("therapy_complete")) {
  palliative_relapse <- therapy_complete %>%
    filter(setting_clean == "Palliative") %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(
      relapse_date = start_date,
      relapse_months = as.numeric(relapse_date - first_known_event) / 30.44
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(relapse_date)) %>%
    distinct(.data[[id_col]], .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), relapse_date, relapse_months)
  
  if (nrow(palliative_relapse) > 0) {
    metastatic_relapse_dates <- palliative_relapse
  }
}

# Get death dates from survival_outcomes if available
death_dates_fig1 <- NULL
if (exists("survival_outcomes")) {
  death_dates_fig1 <- survival_outcomes %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline[[id_col]]) %>%
    filter(death_status_final == 1, !is.na(death_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = set_names("patient_id", id_col)) %>%
    mutate(death_months = as.numeric(death_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), death_date, death_months)
}

# ==============================
# Prepare data for swimmer plots by therapy setting
# ==============================

# Categorize patients into new groups:
# 1. Neoadjuvant only (no adjuvant, no palliative)
# 2. Adjuvant only (with or without neoadjuvant, but no palliative)
# 3. Any palliative therapy (regardless of what else)
# 4. Any clinical trial (and no other settings)

patient_setting_labels <- therapy_periods %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    has_neoadjuvant = any(setting_label == "Neoadjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
    has_adjuvant = any(setting_label == "Adjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
    has_palliative = any(setting_label == "Palliative", na.rm = TRUE),
    has_clinical_trial = any(setting_label == "Clinical trial", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_category = case_when(
      has_palliative ~ "Any Palliative Therapy",
      has_adjuvant ~ "Adjuvant (with or without Neoadjuvant)",
      has_neoadjuvant ~ "Neoadjuvant Only",
      has_clinical_trial ~ "Clinical Trial Only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Identify available categories
available_categories <- c(
  "Neoadjuvant Only",
  "Adjuvant (with or without Neoadjuvant)",
  "Any Palliative Therapy",
  "Clinical Trial Only"
)

available_categories <- available_categories[available_categories %in% unique(patient_setting_labels$plot_category)]
invisible(cat("Available plot categories:", paste(available_categories, collapse = ", "), "\n"))

# Function to create swimmer plot for a specific category
create_setting_plot <- function(category_name) {
  # Get patients in this category
  patients_this_category <- patient_setting_labels %>%
    filter(plot_category == category_name) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  if (length(patients_this_category) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Sample if too many patients
  n_show <- min(30, length(patients_this_category))
  if (length(patients_this_category) > n_show) {
    set.seed(123)
    patients_this_category <- sample(patients_this_category, size = n_show, replace = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Order patients by first known event
  patient_order <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    arrange(first_known_event, .data[[id_col]]) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  # Prepare plot data
  plot_timeline_setting <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      follow_up_months = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event) / 30.44
    )
  
  plot_ctdna_setting <- on_treatment_ctdna %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      ctdna_detectable = ctdna_value > 0
    )
  
  # Get all therapy periods for these patients
  plot_therapy_setting <- therapy_periods %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    left_join(plot_timeline_setting %>% select(all_of(id_col), follow_up_months), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      end_months_final = ifelse(is.na(end_months), follow_up_months, end_months),
      # Ensure setting_label is properly formatted
      setting_label = case_when(
        setting_label == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
        setting_label == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
        setting_label == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
        is.na(setting_label) | setting_label == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
        TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
      )
    )
  
  # Get surgery dates - already calculated relative to first_known_event
  plot_surgery_setting <- if (!is.null(surgery_dates) && nrow(surgery_dates) > 0) {
    surgery_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_radiation_setting <- if (!is.null(radiation_dates) && nrow(radiation_dates) > 0) {
    radiation_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_relapse_setting <- if (!is.null(metastatic_relapse_dates) && nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates) > 0) {
    metastatic_relapse_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_death_setting <- if (!is.null(death_dates_fig1) && nrow(death_dates_fig1) > 0) {
    death_dates_fig1 %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  # Calculate x-axis limits - include all events to ensure they're visible
  x_min_data <- c(
    plot_therapy_setting$start_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_surgery_setting) && nrow(plot_surgery_setting) > 0) plot_surgery_setting$surgery_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_radiation_setting) && nrow(plot_radiation_setting) > 0) plot_radiation_setting$rad_months else NULL,
    plot_ctdna_setting$months_from_anchor
  )
  x_max_data <- c(
    plot_timeline_setting$follow_up_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_relapse_setting) && nrow(plot_relapse_setting) > 0) plot_relapse_setting$relapse_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_death_setting) && nrow(plot_death_setting) > 0) plot_death_setting$death_months else NULL,
    plot_therapy_setting$end_months_final
  )
  x_min <- floor(min(x_min_data, na.rm = TRUE)) - 3
  x_max <- ceiling(max(x_max_data, na.rm = TRUE)) + 3
  # Ensure x_min is at most 0 (don't extend too far into negative)
  x_min <- max(x_min, -12)
  x_breaks <- seq(floor(x_min / 6) * 6, ceiling(x_max / 6) * 6, by = 6)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Per-patient follow-up interval bars
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_timeline_setting,
      aes(x = 0, xend = follow_up_months,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered),
      linewidth = 3, color = "gray85", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    # Therapy period bars (all therapy periods for these patients)
    # Color by setting to show transitions clearly
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_therapy_setting,
      aes(x = start_months, 
          xend = end_months_final,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered,
          color = setting_label),
      linewidth = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    # ctDNA positive markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_setting %>% filter(ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # ctDNA negative markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_setting %>% filter(!ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # Cystectomy events
    {if (!is.null(plot_surgery_setting) && nrow(plot_surgery_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_surgery_setting,
        aes(x = surgery_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue"
      )
    }} +
    # Radiation events
    {if (!is.null(plot_radiation_setting) && nrow(plot_radiation_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_radiation_setting,
        aes(x = rad_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange"
      )
    }} +
    # Metastatic relapse events - make more distinct
    {if (!is.null(plot_relapse_setting) && nrow(plot_relapse_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_relapse_setting,
        aes(x = relapse_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2
      )
    }} +
    # Death events
    {if (!is.null(plot_death_setting) && nrow(plot_death_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_death_setting,
        aes(x = death_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 4, shape = 8, color = "black", stroke = 1.5
      )
    }} +
    # Vertical line at anchor (time anchor = 0)
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Color scales for therapy setting
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Neoadjuvant" = "#4E79A7",      # Blue
        "Adjuvant" = "#59A14F",          # Green
        "Palliative" = "#9C755F",        # Brown/Tan (changed from red for better distinction)
        "Clinical trial" = "#F28E2B"      # Orange
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(category_name, " (n = ", length(patient_order), ")"),
      x = "Time from First Known Event (months)",
      y = "Patient ID"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(l = 10, r = 8, t = 8, b = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0.02, 0))
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots for each category
plots_list <- list()
for (category in available_categories) {
  p_category <- create_setting_plot(category)
  if (!is.null(p_category)) {
    plots_list[[category]] <- p_category
  }
}

# Arrange plots in grid
if (length(plots_list) > 0) {
  # Order categories as specified
  category_order <- c(
    "Neoadjuvant Only",
    "Adjuvant (with or without Neoadjuvant)",
    "Any Palliative Therapy",
    "Clinical Trial Only"
  )
  plots_ordered <- plots_list[intersect(category_order, names(plots_list))]
  if (length(plots_ordered) < length(plots_list)) {
    plots_ordered <- c(plots_ordered, plots_list[setdiff(names(plots_list), names(plots_ordered))])
  }
  
  if (length(plots_ordered) == 1) {
    combined_plot <- plots_ordered[[1]]
  } else if (length(plots_ordered) == 2) {
    combined_plot <- plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]
  } else if (length(plots_ordered) == 3) {
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]) / plots_ordered[[3]]
  } else {
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]) / (plots_ordered[[3]] | plots_ordered[[4]])
  }
  
  # Create legend plot with visual elements
  legend_plot <- ggplot() +
    # ctDNA positive
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.9, label = "ctDNA+", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # ctDNA negative
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.8, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.8, label = "ctDNA-", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Cystectomy
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.7, size = 4, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.7, label = "Cystectomy", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Radiation
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.6, size = 4, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.6, label = "Radiation", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Relapse - make more distinct
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.5, size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.5, label = "Metastatic relapse", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Death
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.4, size = 4, shape = 8, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.4, label = "Death", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Neoadjuvant
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.3, yend = 0.3, linewidth = 4, color = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.3, label = "Neoadjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Adjuvant
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.2, yend = 0.2, linewidth = 4, color = "#59A14F", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.2, label = "Adjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Palliative
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.1, yend = 0.1, linewidth = 4, color = "#9C755F", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.1, label = "Palliative", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Clinical trial
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.0, yend = 0.0, linewidth = 4, color = "#F28E2B", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.0, label = "Clinical trial", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # Add overall title and combine with legend
  combined_plot <- combined_plot +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "ctDNA dynamics of lower tract urothelial carcinoma patients receiving systemic therapy",
      subtitle = "Time anchored at first known event (first ctDNA, first therapy start, or follow-up start). Separate plots by therapy category. Bars colored by setting (Neoadjuvant=blue, Adjuvant=green, Palliative=brown, Clinical trial=orange).",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5)
      )
    )
  
  # Combine plot with legend on the right (adjust widths: plots get more space)
  final_plot <- combined_plot | legend_plot
  final_plot <- final_plot + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))
  
  invisible(print(final_plot))
  
  invisible(cat("\nSwimmer plots created for", length(plots_ordered), "category/categories:", paste(names(plots_ordered), collapse = ", "), "\n"))
} else {
  invisible(cat("\nNo patients found for the specified therapy categories.\n"))
}
```

```{r figure2_upper_tract_swimmer, fig.width=18, fig.height=14, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Figure 2: ctDNA dynamics of upper tract urothelial carcinoma patients and variant histologies"}
# ==============================
# Figure 2: Upper Tract Swimmer Plot
# Separate plots by histology type, include all UTUC patients (not just those with systemic therapy)
# Filter out bladder patients (those go to Figure 1)
# ==============================


# Use combined dataset (all patients now in Master1, including upper tract)
# Filter for upper tract and variant histology patients (robust to missing columns)
primary_loc_cols_upper_fig <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("primary.*tumor.*location|primary.*site|tumor.*location", ignore_case = TRUE))]
histology_cols_upper_fig <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("histology|pathology.*histology", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Expand variant histology capture to include squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, micropapillary, small cell, plasmacytoid
variant_regex <- "neuroendocrine|sarcomatoid|variant|differentiation|squamous|adenocarcinoma|micropapillary|small\\s*cell|plasmacytoid"

dat_upper_fig <- dat_combined %>%
  mutate(
    primary_loc_tmp = if (length(primary_loc_cols_upper_fig) > 0) .data[[primary_loc_cols_upper_fig[1]]] else NA_character_,
    histology_tmp = if (length(histology_cols_upper_fig) > 0) .data[[histology_cols_upper_fig[1]]] else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(tolower(primary_loc_tmp), "renal|pelvis|upper|utuc") |
      str_detect(tolower(histology_tmp), variant_regex)
  ) %>%
  select(-primary_loc_tmp, -histology_tmp)

var_names_unique_upper_fig <- names(dat_upper_fig)

# Identify ID column safely
id_col_upper_fig <- if ("patient_id" %in% names(dat_upper_fig)) "patient_id" else names(dat_upper_fig)[1]

# Get patient characteristics for upper tract/variant patients (robust to missing columns)
primary_site_cols_upper_fig <- names(dat_upper_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_upper_fig), regex("primary.*tumor.*location|primary.*site|tumor.*location", ignore_case = TRUE))]

patient_characteristics_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id = .data[[id_col_upper_fig]],
    histology = if (length(histology_cols_upper_fig) > 0) .data[[histology_cols_upper_fig[1]]] else NA_character_,
    primary_site = if (length(primary_site_cols_upper_fig) > 0) .data[[primary_site_cols_upper_fig[1]]] else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    histology = str_trim(as.character(histology)),
    histology = ifelse(is.na(histology) | histology == "" | histology == "NA" | histology == "N/A", "Unknown", histology),
    histology = str_replace_all(histology, regex("urothelial/transitional|transitional/urothelial", ignore_case = TRUE), "urothelial"),
    primary_site = str_trim(as.character(primary_site)),
    primary_site = ifelse(is.na(primary_site) | primary_site == "" | primary_site == "NA" | primary_site == "N/A", "Unknown", primary_site)
  )

# Use existing ctDNA long data filtered for these patients
ctdna_long_upper_fig <- ctdna_long %>%
  filter(patient_id %in% dat_upper_fig$patient_id)

# Build therapy long data (include all patients, not just those with systemic therapy)
therapy_long_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
  select(patient_id, matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_raw), regimen_raw != "")

# Get ctDNA timeline per patient (include all patients, not just those with ctDNA)
ctdna_timeline_upper_fig <- ctdna_long_upper_fig %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]]) %>%
  summarise(
    first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get follow-up dates
follow_up_cols_upper_fig <- names(dat_upper_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_upper_fig), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date|last.*visit.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(follow_up_cols_upper_fig) > 0) {
  follow_up_dates_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
    select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), all_of(follow_up_cols_upper_fig[1])) %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = all_of(follow_up_cols_upper_fig[1])) %>%
    mutate(follow_up_date = as_date_safe(follow_up_date))
} else {
  # Use last ctDNA date as proxy if no follow-up date column
  follow_up_dates_upper_fig <- ctdna_timeline_upper_fig %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = last_ctdna_date)
  invisible(cat("Note: Using last ctDNA date as follow-up date proxy\n"))
}

# Build therapy start/end data
therapy_start_dates_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
  select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_start_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_upper_fig), names_to = "var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw))

# Get first therapy start date per patient
first_therapy_start_upper_fig <- therapy_start_dates_upper_fig %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]]) %>%
  summarise(first_therapy_start = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Get first surgery date per patient (for upper tract, this might be nephroureterectomy or other procedures)
first_surgery_date_upper_fig <- NULL
surgery_date_cols_temp_upper_fig <- names(dat_upper_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_upper_fig), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(surgery_date_cols_temp_upper_fig) > 0) {
  surgery_data_temp_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
    select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), all_of(surgery_date_cols_temp_upper_fig)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_upper_fig), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]]) %>%
    summarise(first_surgery_date = min(surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  first_surgery_date_upper_fig <- surgery_data_temp_upper_fig
}

# Start with ALL patients from dat_upper_fig, not just those with ctDNA data
# This ensures all UTUC patients are included even if they don't have ctDNA dates
all_patients_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
  select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig)) %>%
  distinct()

# Also include patients from dat_combined who have variant histologies (neuroendocrine, sarcomatoid, etc.)
# These might be in the lower tract dataset but should appear in Figure 2
if (exists("dat_combined") && "histology_clean" %in% names(dat_combined) && "patient_id" %in% names(dat_combined)) {
  variant_histology_patients <- dat_combined %>%
    filter(!is.na(histology_clean), 
           histology_clean != "",
           str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "neuroendocrine|sarcomatoid|variant|differentiation"),
           # Exclude UC of bladder
           !(str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "urothelial") & 
             str_detect(tolower(primary_site_clean), "bladder"))) %>%
    select(patient_id) %>%
    distinct()
  
  if (nrow(variant_histology_patients) > 0) {
    # Convert patient_id to match id_col_upper_fig format
    variant_patients_formatted <- variant_histology_patients %>%
      mutate(!!sym(id_col_upper_fig) := as.character(patient_id)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig))
    
    # Find patients to add (those not already in all_patients_upper_fig)
    existing_ids <- all_patients_upper_fig[[id_col_upper_fig]]
    new_variant_patients <- variant_patients_formatted %>%
      filter(!.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% existing_ids)
    
    if (nrow(new_variant_patients) > 0) {
      # Add variant histology patients that aren't already in all_patients_upper_fig
      all_patients_upper_fig <- bind_rows(
        all_patients_upper_fig,
        new_variant_patients
      ) %>%
        distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)
      
      invisible(cat("Added", nrow(new_variant_patients),
          "variant histology patients from combined dataset\n"))
    }
  }
}

# Ensure all_patients_upper_fig has no duplicates
all_patients_upper_fig <- all_patients_upper_fig %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)


# For variant histology patients from combined dataset, we need to get their timeline data
# Check which patients in all_patients_upper_fig are from the combined dataset (not in dat_upper_fig)
variant_patient_ids <- all_patients_upper_fig[[id_col_upper_fig]]
upper_tract_patient_ids <- dat_upper_fig[[id_col_upper_fig]]
variant_only_ids <- setdiff(variant_patient_ids, upper_tract_patient_ids)

# If we have variant histology patients not in dat_upper_fig, we need to get their timeline from dat_combined
if (length(variant_only_ids) > 0 && exists("dat_combined") && "patient_id" %in% names(dat_combined)) {
  invisible(cat("Building timeline data for", length(variant_only_ids), "variant histology patients from combined dataset\n"))
  
  # Get ctDNA data for variant patients from combined dataset
  if (exists("ctdna_long")) {
    variant_ctdna_timeline <- ctdna_long %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% variant_only_ids) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(
        first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(!!sym(id_col_upper_fig) := as.character(patient_id)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), first_ctdna_date, last_ctdna_date)
    
    # Add to ctdna_timeline_upper_fig
    ctdna_timeline_upper_fig <- bind_rows(
      ctdna_timeline_upper_fig,
      variant_ctdna_timeline
    )
  }
  
  # Get follow-up dates for variant patients (extract from dat_combined)
  # This is a simplified version - in practice, you'd extract from the appropriate dataset
  # For now, we'll use NA and let the code handle it
  # Only add variant patients that aren't already in follow_up_dates_upper_fig
  existing_fu_ids <- if (nrow(follow_up_dates_upper_fig) > 0) {
    follow_up_dates_upper_fig[[id_col_upper_fig]]
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  variant_follow_up <- tibble(
    !!sym(id_col_upper_fig) := variant_only_ids[!variant_only_ids %in% existing_fu_ids],
    follow_up_date = as.Date(NA)
  )
  
  if (nrow(variant_follow_up) > 0) {
    follow_up_dates_upper_fig <- bind_rows(
      follow_up_dates_upper_fig,
      variant_follow_up
    )
  }
  
  # Get therapy start dates for variant patients (simplified - would need to extract from dat_combined)
  existing_therapy_ids <- if (nrow(first_therapy_start_upper_fig) > 0) {
    first_therapy_start_upper_fig[[id_col_upper_fig]]
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  variant_therapy_start <- tibble(
    !!sym(id_col_upper_fig) := variant_only_ids[!variant_only_ids %in% existing_therapy_ids],
    first_therapy_start = as.Date(NA)
  )
  
  if (nrow(variant_therapy_start) > 0) {
    first_therapy_start_upper_fig <- bind_rows(
      first_therapy_start_upper_fig,
      variant_therapy_start
    )
  }
  
  # Get surgery dates for variant patients (simplified)
  existing_surgery_ids <- if (!is.null(first_surgery_date_upper_fig) && nrow(first_surgery_date_upper_fig) > 0) {
    first_surgery_date_upper_fig[[id_col_upper_fig]]
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  variant_surgery <- tibble(
    !!sym(id_col_upper_fig) := variant_only_ids[!variant_only_ids %in% existing_surgery_ids],
    first_surgery_date = as.Date(NA)
  )
  
  if (nrow(variant_surgery) > 0) {
    if (!is.null(first_surgery_date_upper_fig)) {
      first_surgery_date_upper_fig <- bind_rows(
        first_surgery_date_upper_fig,
        variant_surgery
      )
    } else {
      first_surgery_date_upper_fig <- variant_surgery
    }
  }
}

# Ensure all joined tables have unique patient IDs before joining
ctdna_timeline_upper_fig <- ctdna_timeline_upper_fig %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)
follow_up_dates_upper_fig <- follow_up_dates_upper_fig %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)
first_therapy_start_upper_fig <- first_therapy_start_upper_fig %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)
if (!is.null(first_surgery_date_upper_fig)) {
  first_surgery_date_upper_fig <- first_surgery_date_upper_fig %>%
    distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Combine patient timeline info and calculate first known event
# Start with all patients and left join all timeline data
patient_timeline_upper_fig <- all_patients_upper_fig %>%
  left_join(ctdna_timeline_upper_fig, by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
  left_join(follow_up_dates_upper_fig, by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
  left_join(first_therapy_start_upper_fig, by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
  {if (!is.null(first_surgery_date_upper_fig)) {
    left_join(., first_surgery_date_upper_fig, by = id_col_upper_fig)
  } else {
    mutate(., first_surgery_date = as.Date(NA))
  }} %>%
  mutate(
    # First known event = minimum of: first ctDNA, first therapy start, first surgery, follow-up start
    # Handle case where all are NA (use a default date or keep as NA)
    first_known_event = case_when(
      !is.na(first_ctdna_date) | !is.na(first_therapy_start) | !is.na(first_surgery_date) | !is.na(follow_up_date) ~
        pmin(
          first_ctdna_date,
          first_therapy_start,
          first_surgery_date,
          follow_up_date,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    # Use follow-up date or last ctDNA date as end anchor
    time_anchor = coalesce(follow_up_date, last_ctdna_date),
    # If no time_anchor but we have first_known_event, use that
    time_anchor = case_when(
      !is.na(time_anchor) ~ time_anchor,
      !is.na(first_known_event) ~ first_known_event,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    # Per-patient bar: time from first known event to last follow-up
    follow_up_interval_days = case_when(
      !is.na(time_anchor) & !is.na(first_known_event) ~ as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    follow_up_interval_months = follow_up_interval_days / 30.44
  ) %>%
  # Ensure time_anchor and first_known_event are Date objects
  mutate(
    time_anchor = as.Date(time_anchor),
    first_known_event = as.Date(first_known_event)
  )

# Add histology and primary site to patient timeline
# Use histology_clean from dat_combined to match the histology frequency table
patient_timeline_upper_fig <- patient_timeline_upper_fig %>%
  left_join(patient_characteristics_upper_fig, by = id_col_upper_fig)

# Join with histology_clean from dat_combined to get the same histology categories as Table 1
# This ensures we capture ALL histologies that appear in the histology frequency table
if (exists("dat_combined") && "histology_clean" %in% names(dat_combined)) {
  id_col_main <- if ("patient_id" %in% names(dat_combined)) "patient_id" else id_col_upper_fig
  
  # Get histology map from combined dataset - include ALL patients to capture all histologies
  histology_map_combined <- dat_combined %>%
    transmute(
      id_join = as.character(.data[[id_col_main]]),
      histology_clean,
      primary_site_clean = if ("primary_site_clean" %in% names(dat_combined)) primary_site_clean else NA_character_
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(histology_clean), histology_clean != "")
  
  if (nrow(histology_map_combined) > 0) {
    patient_timeline_upper_fig <- patient_timeline_upper_fig %>%
      mutate(id_join = as.character(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]])) %>%
      left_join(histology_map_combined, by = "id_join") %>%
      mutate(
        # Prefer histology_clean from combined dataset (matches Table 1), fall back to row 16 histology
        histology = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(histology_clean), as.character(histology)),
        # Also update primary_site from combined dataset if available
        primary_site = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(primary_site_clean), as.character(primary_site))
      ) %>%
      select(-histology_clean, -primary_site_clean, -id_join)
  }
}

patient_timeline_upper_fig <- patient_timeline_upper_fig %>%
  mutate(
    histology = ifelse(is.na(histology), "Unknown", histology),
    primary_site = ifelse(is.na(primary_site) | primary_site == "", "Unknown", primary_site)
  ) %>%
  # Remove any duplicate patient IDs (keep first occurrence)
  distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE)

invisible(cat("Histology types:", paste(unique(patient_timeline_upper_fig$histology), collapse = ", "), "\n"))

# Get all ctDNA data for all patients (anchored to first known event)
plot_ctdna_upper_fig <- ctdna_long_upper_fig %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline_upper_fig %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), time_anchor, first_known_event), by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
  mutate(
    # Time from first known event (anchor = 0)
    months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    ctdna_status = case_when(
      ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
      ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Build therapy end data
therapy_end_dates_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
  select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_end_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_upper_fig), names_to = "var", values_to = "end_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(end_date = as_date_safe(end_date_raw))

therapy_settings_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
  select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_treatment_setting$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_upper_fig), names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var)

# Combine therapy information
therapy_complete_upper_fig <- therapy_long_upper_fig %>%
  left_join(therapy_start_dates_upper_fig %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), therapy_idx, start_date), 
            by = c(id_col_upper_fig, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_end_dates_upper_fig %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), therapy_idx, end_date), 
            by = c(id_col_upper_fig, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_settings_upper_fig %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), therapy_idx, setting_raw), 
            by = c(id_col_upper_fig, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_clean = clean_regimen(regimen_raw),
    setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw),
    therapy_type = categorize_therapy_type(regimen_raw)
  )

# Get therapy periods relative to first known event
therapy_periods_upper_fig <- therapy_complete_upper_fig %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline_upper_fig %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), first_known_event, time_anchor), by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
  mutate(
    start_months = as.numeric(start_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    end_months = case_when(
      !is.na(end_date) ~ as.numeric(end_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Clean setting for labeling
    setting_label = case_when(
      setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
      is.na(setting_clean) | setting_clean == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
      TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), start_months, end_months, therapy_type, regimen_clean, setting_clean, setting_label)

# Get surgery dates (relative to first known event)
surgery_date_cols_upper_fig <- names(dat_upper_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_upper_fig), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_dates_upper_fig <- NULL
if (length(surgery_date_cols_upper_fig) > 0) {
  surgery_dates_upper_fig <- dat_upper_fig %>%
    select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), all_of(surgery_date_cols_upper_fig)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_upper_fig), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline_upper_fig %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), first_known_event), by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
    mutate(surgery_months = as.numeric(surgery_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%

# Get radiation dates (relative to first known event)

# Get metastatic relapse dates (relative to first known event)
metastatic_relapse_cols_upper_fig <- names(dat_upper_fig)[str_detect(names(dat_upper_fig), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Fallback: if no relapse dates captured, use start of first palliative therapy as relapse proxy for upper tract/variant patients
if ((is.null(metastatic_relapse_dates_upper_fig) || nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates_upper_fig) == 0) && exists("therapy_complete")) {
  palliative_relapse_upper <- therapy_complete %>%

    mutate(
      relapse_date = start_date,

# Get unique histology types, excluding NA/Unknown
histology_types_upper_fig <- unique(patient_timeline_upper_fig$histology)

]

# Function to create swimmer plot for a specific histology type
create_histology_plot_upper_fig <- function(histology_name) {
  # Get patients with this histology
  # Exclude urothelial cell carcinoma of the bladder (UC of bladder) from Figure 2
  # Include ALL patients with this histology, even if they don't have timeline events
  patients_this_histology <- patient_timeline_upper_fig %>%
    filter(
      histology == histology_name,
      !(str_detect(tolower(histology), "urothelial") &
          str_detect(tolower(primary_site), "bladder"))
    ) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]])
  
  if (length(patients_this_histology) == 0) {
    invisible(cat("  No patients found for histology:", histology_name, "\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  
  # Order patients by first known event, then by primary site
  # Ensure unique patient IDs (remove any duplicates)
  patient_order <- patient_timeline_upper_fig %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    distinct(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(first_known_event, primary_site, .data[[id_col_upper_fig]]) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]]) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique()
  
  # Remove any NA values
  patient_order <- patient_order[!is.na(patient_order)]
  
  # Prepare plot data
  # Handle patients without timeline events by creating a minimal timeline
  plot_timeline_histology <- patient_timeline_upper_fig %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    mutate(
      # If no first_known_event, create a dummy one (use today's date or a default)
      first_known_event = case_when(
        !is.na(first_known_event) ~ first_known_event,
        !is.na(time_anchor) ~ time_anchor,
        TRUE ~ as.Date("2020-01-01")  # Default anchor for patients without events
      ),
      # If no time_anchor, use first_known_event + 1 month as default
      time_anchor = case_when(
        !is.na(time_anchor) ~ time_anchor,
        !is.na(first_known_event) ~ first_known_event + days(30),
        TRUE ~ as.Date("2020-02-01")  # Default end for patients without events
      ),
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order),
      follow_up_months = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      # Create label with patient ID and primary site
      patient_label = paste0(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], " (", primary_site, ")")
    )
  
  plot_ctdna_histology <- plot_ctdna_upper_fig %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order),
      ctdna_detectable = ctdna_value > 0
    )
  
  # Get all therapy periods for these patients
  plot_therapy_histology <- therapy_periods_upper_fig %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    left_join(plot_timeline_histology %>% select(all_of(id_col_upper_fig), follow_up_months), by = id_col_upper_fig) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order),
      end_months_final = ifelse(is.na(end_months), follow_up_months, end_months),
      setting_label = case_when(
        setting_label == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
        setting_label == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
        setting_label == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
        is.na(setting_label) | setting_label == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
        TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
      )
    )
  
  # Get therapy type labels for each patient (for display on plot)
  therapy_labels_histology <- plot_therapy_histology %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]]) %>%
    summarise(
      therapy_types = paste(unique(therapy_type), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order),
      # Position label at start of first therapy or at 0 if no therapy
      label_x = 0,
      label_y = as.numeric(patient_id_ordered)
    )
  
  # Get surgery dates
  plot_surgery_histology <- if (!is.null(surgery_dates_upper_fig) && nrow(surgery_dates_upper_fig) > 0) {
    surgery_dates_upper_fig %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_radiation_histology <- if (!is.null(radiation_dates_upper_fig) && nrow(radiation_dates_upper_fig) > 0) {
    radiation_dates_upper_fig %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_relapse_histology <- if (!is.null(metastatic_relapse_dates_upper_fig) && nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates_upper_fig) > 0) {
    metastatic_relapse_dates_upper_fig %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_death_histology <- if (!is.null(death_dates_upper_fig) && nrow(death_dates_upper_fig) > 0) {
    death_dates_upper_fig %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col_upper_fig]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  # Calculate x-axis limits
  x_min_data <- c(
    plot_therapy_histology$start_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_surgery_histology) && nrow(plot_surgery_histology) > 0) plot_surgery_histology$surgery_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_radiation_histology) && nrow(plot_radiation_histology) > 0) plot_radiation_histology$rad_months else NULL,
    plot_ctdna_histology$months_from_anchor
  )
  x_max_data <- c(
    plot_timeline_histology$follow_up_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_relapse_histology) && nrow(plot_relapse_histology) > 0) plot_relapse_histology$relapse_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_death_histology) && nrow(plot_death_histology) > 0) plot_death_histology$death_months else NULL,
    plot_therapy_histology$end_months_final
  )
  x_min <- floor(min(x_min_data, na.rm = TRUE)) - 3
  x_max <- ceiling(max(x_max_data, na.rm = TRUE)) + 3
  x_min <- max(x_min, -12)
  x_breaks <- seq(floor(x_min / 6) * 6, ceiling(x_max / 6) * 6, by = 6)
  
  # Create labels for y-axis with primary site
  y_labels <- plot_timeline_histology %>%
    arrange(patient_id_ordered) %>%
    distinct(patient_id_ordered, primary_site) %>%
    mutate(y_label = paste0(patient_id_ordered, " (", primary_site, ")")) %>%
    pull(y_label)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Per-patient follow-up interval bars
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_timeline_histology,
      aes(x = 0, xend = follow_up_months,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered),
      linewidth = 3, color = "gray85", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    # Therapy period bars (color by setting)
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_therapy_histology,
      aes(x = start_months, 
          xend = end_months_final,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered,
          color = setting_label),
      linewidth = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    # Add therapy type labels on the left side of the plot
    {if (nrow(therapy_labels_histology) > 0) {
      geom_text(
        data = therapy_labels_histology,
        aes(x = label_x, y = patient_id_ordered, label = therapy_types),
        hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5, color = "black", nudge_x = -1
      )
    }} +
    # ctDNA positive markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_histology %>% filter(ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # ctDNA negative markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_histology %>% filter(!ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # Surgery events
    {if (!is.null(plot_surgery_histology) && nrow(plot_surgery_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_surgery_histology,
        aes(x = surgery_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue"
      )
    }} +
    # Radiation events
    {if (!is.null(plot_radiation_histology) && nrow(plot_radiation_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_radiation_histology,
        aes(x = rad_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange"
      )
    }} +
    # Metastatic relapse events
    {if (!is.null(plot_relapse_histology) && nrow(plot_relapse_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_relapse_histology,
        aes(x = relapse_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2
      )
    }} +
    # Death events
    {if (!is.null(plot_death_histology) && nrow(plot_death_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_death_histology,
        aes(x = death_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 4, shape = 8, color = "black", stroke = 1.5
      )
    }} +
    # Vertical line at anchor (time anchor = 0)
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Color scales for therapy setting
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Neoadjuvant" = "#4E79A7",      # Blue
        "Adjuvant" = "#59A14F",          # Green
        "Palliative" = "#9C755F",        # Brown/Tan
        "Clinical trial" = "#F28E2B"      # Orange
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(histology_name, " (n = ", length(patient_order), ")"),
      x = "Time from First Known Event (months)",
      y = "Patient ID (Primary Site)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(l = 10, r = 8, t = 8, b = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0.02, 0))
  
  return(p)
}

  # Add overall title and combine with legend
  combined_plot_upper_fig <- combined_plot_upper_fig +

  final_plot_upper_fig <- final_plot_upper_fig + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))

```{r figure3_os_curves, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%", eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, fig.cap="Figure 3: Overall Survival (OS) curves by Qualitative, Quantitative, and ML-based ctDNA response criteria using Time-Dependent Cox Models"}
# ==============================
# Figure 3: OS Curves for Qual vs Quant vs ML
# Using Time-Dependent Cox Models to account for time-varying ctDNA status
# ==============================

# Function to create time-dependent dataset for a specific grouping variable
create_timedep_data_for_group <- function(ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, group_data, group_var_name) {
  # Merge survival outcomes with group assignments
  surv_with_group <- survival_outcomes %>%
    left_join(group_data %>% select(patient_id, !!sym(group_var_name)), by = "patient_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var_name]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var_name]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  # Start with survival outcomes - handle missing time_anchor
  if ("time_anchor" %in% names(surv_with_group)) {
    surv_base <- surv_with_group %>%
      select(patient_id, time_anchor, os_time, death_event, !!sym(group_var_name)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > 0, !is.na(death_event), !is.na(time_anchor))
  } else {
    # If no time_anchor, create it from baseline_ctdna
    surv_base <- surv_with_group %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, as.Date(Sys.Date()))) %>%
      select(patient_id, time_anchor, os_time, death_event, !!sym(group_var_name)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > 0, !is.na(death_event), !is.na(time_anchor))
  }
  
  if (nrow(surv_base) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get all ctDNA measurements with time from anchor
  ctdna_timed <- ctdna_long %>%
    left_join(surv_base %>% select(patient_id, time_anchor, !!sym(group_var_name)), by = "patient_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(time_anchor), !is.na(ctdna_date), !is.na(ctdna_value),
           !is.na(.data[[group_var_name]])) %>%
    mutate(
      months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - time_anchor) / 30.44,
      ctdna_status = case_when(
        ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
        ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_status), ctdna_status != "Unknown", months_from_anchor >= 0) %>%
    arrange(patient_id, months_from_anchor)
  
  if (nrow(ctdna_timed) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create time intervals for each patient
  timedep_list <- list()
  
  for (pid in unique(ctdna_timed$patient_id)) {
    patient_ctdna <- ctdna_timed %>% filter(patient_id == pid)
    patient_surv <- surv_base %>% filter(patient_id == pid)
    
    if (nrow(patient_ctdna) == 0 || nrow(patient_surv) == 0) next
    
    # Get baseline status
    baseline_val <- baseline_ctdna %>% 
      filter(patient_id == pid) %>% 
      pull(baseline_value)
    
    initial_status <- if (length(baseline_val) > 0 && !is.na(baseline_val)) {
      if (baseline_val == 0) "Negative" else "Positive"
    } else {
      first(patient_ctdna$ctdna_status)
    }
    
    # Start with interval from time 0 to first measurement
    if (nrow(patient_ctdna) > 0) {
      first_measure_time <- first(patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor)
      
      intervals <- tibble(
        patient_id = pid,
        tstart = 0,
        tstop = first_measure_time,
        ctdna_status = initial_status,
        group = first(patient_surv[[group_var_name]])
      )
      
      # Add intervals between measurements
      if (nrow(patient_ctdna) > 1) {
        for (i in 1:(nrow(patient_ctdna) - 1)) {
          intervals <- bind_rows(
            intervals,
            tibble(
              patient_id = pid,
              tstart = patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor[i],
              tstop = patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor[i + 1],
              ctdna_status = patient_ctdna$ctdna_status[i],
              group = first(patient_surv[[group_var_name]])
            )
          )
        }
      }
      
      # Add final interval from last measurement to end of follow-up
      last_measurement_time <- max(patient_ctdna$months_from_anchor)
      final_status <- last(patient_ctdna$ctdna_status)
      
      intervals <- bind_rows(
        intervals,
        tibble(
          patient_id = pid,
          tstart = last_measurement_time,
          tstop = patient_surv$os_time,
          ctdna_status = final_status,
          group = first(patient_surv[[group_var_name]])
        )
      )
      
      # Add event indicator to final interval only
      intervals$event <- c(rep(0, nrow(intervals) - 1), patient_surv$death_event)
      
      timedep_list[[pid]] <- intervals
    }
  }
  
  if (length(timedep_list) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  timedep_data <- bind_rows(timedep_list)
  return(timedep_data)
}

# Function to calculate IPCW weights (stabilized)
calculate_ipcw_weights <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var) {
  # Create censoring indicator (1 = censored, 0 = event)
  data_with_cens <- data %>%
    mutate(
      censored = 1 - .data[[event_var]],
      surv_time = .data[[time_var]],
      surv_group = .data[[group_var]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surv_time), surv_time > 0, !is.na(surv_group))
  
  if (nrow(data_with_cens) == 0) {
    return(data %>% mutate(ipcw_weight = 1))
  }
  
  # Fit Cox model for censoring (predicting censoring, not death)
  censoring_cox <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(surv_time, censored) ~ surv_group, data = data_with_cens)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(censoring_cox)) {
    # If model fails, return uniform weights
    return(data_with_cens %>% mutate(ipcw_weight = 1))
  }
  
  # Get baseline survival function for censoring (marginal, no covariates)
  marginal_censoring_surv <- survfit(Surv(surv_time, censored) ~ 1, data = data_with_cens)
  
  # Get conditional survival (by group)
  conditional_censoring_surv <- survfit(censoring_cox, data = data_with_cens)
  
  # Calculate stabilized IPCW weights: P(C > t) / P(C > t | group)
  weights <- numeric(nrow(data_with_cens))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(data_with_cens)) {
    patient_time <- data_with_cens$surv_time[i]
    patient_group <- as.character(data_with_cens$surv_group[i])
    
    # Marginal probability (numerator)
    marginal_times <- marginal_censoring_surv$time
    marginal_probs <- marginal_censoring_surv$surv
    if (length(marginal_times) > 0 && patient_time <= max(marginal_times, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      idx_marg <- which(marginal_times >= patient_time)[1]
      if (!is.na(idx_marg) && idx_marg > 1) {
        prob_marg <- marginal_probs[idx_marg - 1]
      } else if (idx_marg == 1) {
        prob_marg <- marginal_probs[1]
      } else {
        prob_marg <- marginal_probs[length(marginal_probs)]
      }
    } else {
      prob_marg <- ifelse(length(marginal_probs) > 0, marginal_probs[length(marginal_probs)], 1)
    }
    
    # Conditional probability (denominator)
    # Find the appropriate stratum
    strata_names <- names(conditional_censoring_surv$strata)
    group_stratum <- which(str_detect(strata_names, fixed(patient_group)))
    
    if (length(group_stratum) > 0) {
      stratum_idx <- group_stratum[1]
      start_idx <- ifelse(stratum_idx == 1, 1, sum(conditional_censoring_surv$strata[1:(stratum_idx-1)]) + 1)
      end_idx <- sum(conditional_censoring_surv$strata[1:stratum_idx])
      
      cond_times <- conditional_censoring_surv$time[start_idx:end_idx]
      cond_probs <- conditional_censoring_surv$surv[start_idx:end_idx]
      
      if (length(cond_times) > 0 && patient_time <= max(cond_times, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        idx_cond <- which(cond_times >= patient_time)[1]
        if (!is.na(idx_cond) && idx_cond > 1) {
          prob_cond <- cond_probs[idx_cond - 1]
        } else if (idx_cond == 1) {
          prob_cond <- cond_probs[1]
        } else {
          prob_cond <- cond_probs[length(cond_probs)]
        }
      } else {
        prob_cond <- ifelse(length(cond_probs) > 0, cond_probs[length(cond_probs)], 1)
      }
    } else {
      prob_cond <- 1  # If group not found, use uniform weight
    }
    
    # Stabilized IPCW weight: P(C > t) / P(C > t | group)
    # This gives higher weight to groups with lower censoring probability
    if (prob_cond > 0 && prob_marg > 0) {
      weights[i] <- prob_marg / prob_cond
    } else if (prob_cond > 0) {
      # If marginal prob is 0 but conditional > 0, use unstabilized weight
      weights[i] <- 1 / prob_cond
    } else {
      weights[i] <- 1
    }
  }
  
  # Truncate extreme weights (at 99th percentile) to avoid instability
  weight_cutoff <- quantile(weights, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(weight_cutoff) && weight_cutoff > 0) {
    weights <- pmin(weights, weight_cutoff)
  }
  
  # Normalize weights to have mean = 1 (optional, helps with interpretation)
  weights <- weights / mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data_with_cens$ipcw_weight <- weights
  return(data_with_cens)
}

# Function to create KM plot with time-dependent Cox model results and IPCW
create_km_plot_timedep <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var, title, ylab, 
                                    ctdna_long, baseline_ctdna, reference_group = NULL) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    invisible(cat("No valid data for", title, "\n"))
    return(list(plot = NULL, plot_ipcw = NULL, cox_model_standard = NULL, 
                cox_model_timedep = NULL, model_comparison = NULL, censoring_analysis = NULL))
  }
  
  data_plot <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      surv_time = .data[[time_var]],
      surv_event = .data[[event_var]],
      surv_group = .data[[group_var]]
    )
  
  if (is.null(reference_group)) {
    groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
    ref_candidates <- groups[str_detect(tolower(groups), "persistent.*negative|negative.*persistent|persistent.*low")]
    if (length(ref_candidates) > 0) {
      reference_group <- ref_candidates[1]
    } else {
      reference_group <- sort(groups)[1]
    }
  }
  
  # Create time-dependent dataset
  group_data <- data_plot %>% select(patient_id, !!sym(group_var))
  timedep_data <- create_timedep_data_for_group(ctdna_long, survival_outcomes, baseline_ctdna, 
                                                 group_data, group_var)
  
  # Fit standard Cox model for comparison
  cox_model_standard <- NULL
  surv_formula_standard <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
  cox_model_standard <- tryCatch({
    coxph(surv_formula_standard, data = data_plot)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error fitting standard Cox model:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # Fit time-dependent Cox model
  cox_model_timedep <- NULL
  if (!is.null(timedep_data) && nrow(timedep_data) > 0) {
    timedep_data_clean <- timedep_data %>% 
      filter(ctdna_status != "Unknown", !is.na(group))
    
    if (nrow(timedep_data_clean) > 0 && 
        length(unique(timedep_data_clean$ctdna_status)) > 1 &&
        sum(timedep_data_clean$event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      cox_model_timedep <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ ctdna_status + group, data = timedep_data_clean)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error fitting time-dependent Cox model:", e$message, "\n")
        return(NULL)
      })
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate IPCW weights
  cat("\n=== Calculating IPCW weights for", title, "===\n")
  data_plot_ipcw <- calculate_ipcw_weights(data_plot, "surv_time", "surv_event", "surv_group")
  cat("IPCW weights calculated. Rows:", nrow(data_plot_ipcw), 
      "Has ipcw_weight column:", "ipcw_weight" %in% names(data_plot_ipcw), "\n")
  if ("ipcw_weight" %in% names(data_plot_ipcw)) {
    cat("IPCW weight range:", range(data_plot_ipcw$ipcw_weight, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  }
  
  # Fit IPCW-weighted Cox model
  cox_model_ipcw <- NULL
  if ("ipcw_weight" %in% names(data_plot_ipcw)) {
    cox_model_ipcw <- tryCatch({
      coxph(surv_formula_standard, data = data_plot_ipcw, weights = ipcw_weight)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error fitting IPCW-weighted Cox model:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
  
  # Compare model performance (C-index with CI, AIC, and pairwise comparisons)
  model_comparison <- tibble(
    Model = character(0),
    C_Index = numeric(0),
    C_Index_CI_Lower = numeric(0),
    C_Index_CI_Upper = numeric(0),
    AIC = numeric(0),
    N = numeric(0)
  )
  
  # Helper function to calculate C-index with bootstrap CI
  calculate_c_index_ci <- function(cox_model, data, model_type = "standard", n_bootstrap = 200) {
    if (is.null(cox_model) || is.null(data) || nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(list(c_index = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_))
    }
    
    c_index <- tryCatch(summary(cox_model)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
    if (is.na(c_index)) return(list(c_index = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_))
    
    # Try to get asymptotic SE first (faster)
    se <- tryCatch(summary(cox_model)$concordance[2], error = function(e) NA_real_)
    if (!is.na(se) && se > 0) {
      ci_lower <- max(0.5, c_index - 1.96 * se)  # C-index can't be < 0.5
      ci_upper <- min(1.0, c_index + 1.96 * se)  # C-index can't be > 1.0
      return(list(c_index = c_index, ci_lower = ci_lower, ci_upper = ci_upper))
    }
    
    # Bootstrap for CI if SE not available
    c_index_boot <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
    set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
    valid_boots <- 0
    
    for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
      boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(data), nrow(data), replace = TRUE)
      boot_data <- data[boot_idx, ]
      
      # Recreate formula and fit
      tryCatch({
        if (model_type == "ipcw" && "ipcw_weight" %in% names(boot_data)) {
          boot_fit <- coxph(surv_formula_standard, data = boot_data, weights = ipcw_weight)
        } else if (model_type == "timedep") {
          # For time-dependent, need to use the timedep_data structure
          boot_fit <- coxph(Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ ctdna_status + group, data = boot_data)
        } else {
          boot_fit <- coxph(surv_formula_standard, data = boot_data)
        }
        c_boot <- summary(boot_fit)$concordance[1]
        if (!is.na(c_boot) && c_boot > 0 && c_boot <= 1) {
          c_index_boot[i] <- c_boot
          valid_boots <- valid_boots + 1
        }
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
    
    if (valid_boots >= 10) {
      ci_lower <- quantile(c_index_boot[c_index_boot > 0], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
      ci_upper <- quantile(c_index_boot[c_index_boot > 0], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
      ci_lower <- max(0.5, ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
      ci_upper <- min(1.0, ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      # Fallback: use conservative CI
      ci_lower <- max(0.5, c_index - 0.1)
      ci_upper <- min(1.0, c_index + 0.1)
    }
    
    list(c_index = c_index, ci_lower = ci_lower, ci_upper = ci_upper)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_model_standard)) {
    c_index_std_ci <- calculate_c_index_ci(cox_model_standard, data_plot, model_type = "standard")
    aic_std <- tryCatch(AIC(cox_model_standard), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    model_comparison <- bind_rows(
      model_comparison,
      tibble(
        Model = "Standard Cox", 
        C_Index = c_index_std_ci$c_index, 
        C_Index_CI_Lower = c_index_std_ci$ci_lower,
        C_Index_CI_Upper = c_index_std_ci$ci_upper,
        AIC = aic_std, 
        N = nrow(data_plot)
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_model_timedep) && !is.null(timedep_data_clean) && nrow(timedep_data_clean) > 0) {
    c_index_td_ci <- calculate_c_index_ci(cox_model_timedep, timedep_data_clean, model_type = "timedep")
    aic_td <- tryCatch(AIC(cox_model_timedep), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    n_td <- if (!is.null(timedep_data)) length(unique(timedep_data$patient_id)) else 0
