    model_comparison <- bind_rows(
      model_comparison,
      tibble(
        Model = "Time-Dependent Cox", 
        C_Index = c_index_td_ci$c_index, 
        C_Index_CI_Lower = c_index_td_ci$ci_lower,
        C_Index_CI_Upper = c_index_td_ci$ci_upper,
        AIC = aic_td, 
        N = n_td
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_model_ipcw) && !is.null(data_plot_ipcw) && nrow(data_plot_ipcw) > 0) {
    c_index_ipcw_ci <- calculate_c_index_ci(cox_model_ipcw, data_plot_ipcw, model_type = "ipcw")
    aic_ipcw <- tryCatch(AIC(cox_model_ipcw), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    model_comparison <- bind_rows(
      model_comparison,
      tibble(
        Model = "IPCW-Weighted Cox", 
        C_Index = c_index_ipcw_ci$c_index, 
        C_Index_CI_Lower = c_index_ipcw_ci$ci_lower,
        C_Index_CI_Upper = c_index_ipcw_ci$ci_upper,
        AIC = aic_ipcw, 
        N = nrow(data_plot_ipcw)
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Store pairwise comparison data for later use
  # (Will be calculated in the display section where we have all approaches together)
  
  # Calculate pairwise p-values for standard plot
  all_groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
  groups <- all_groups[all_groups != reference_group & !is.na(all_groups)]
  
  pairwise_pvals_list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    data_subset <- data_plot %>%
      filter(surv_group %in% c(reference_group, groups[i]))
    
    if (nrow(data_subset) > 0 && sum(data_subset$surv_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      surv_formula_subset <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
      logrank_test <- tryCatch({
        survdiff(surv_formula_subset, data = data_subset)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(logrank_test)) {
        p_val <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
        pairwise_pvals_list[[groups[i]]] <- p_val
      }
    }
  }
  
  format_pval <- function(p) {
    if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p) || p >= 0.05) return("")
    if (p < 0.001) return("***")
    if (p < 0.01) return("**")
    if (p < 0.05) return("*")
    return("")
  }
  
  # Create standard KM plot
  # Use formula directly to avoid scope issues with ggsurvplot
  surv_formula <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
  fit <- tryCatch({
    survfit(surv_formula, data = data_plot)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating survival fit:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    # Create empty censoring analysis structure for early return
    empty_censoring <- tibble(
      surv_group = character(0),
      n = integer(0),
      n_events = integer(0),
      n_censored = integer(0),
      censoring_rate = numeric(0),
      se = numeric(0)
    )
    return(list(
      plot = NULL, plot_ipcw = NULL, cox_model_standard = cox_model_standard,
      cox_model_timedep = cox_model_timedep, cox_model_ipcw = cox_model_ipcw,
      model_comparison = model_comparison, censoring_analysis = list(
        rates = empty_censoring, chi_square = NULL, kruskal_wallis = NULL
      )
    ))
  }
  
  fit_groups <- names(fit$strata)
  if (is.null(fit_groups) || length(fit_groups) == 0) {
    fit_groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
  } else {
    fit_groups <- sub("^surv_group=", "", fit_groups)
  }
  
  fit_groups <- as.character(fit_groups)
  fit_groups <- fit_groups[!is.na(fit_groups)]
  
  group_labels_with_pval <- character(length(fit_groups))
  names(group_labels_with_pval) <- NULL
  
  for (i in seq_along(fit_groups)) {
    if (fit_groups[i] == reference_group) {
      group_labels_with_pval[i] <- fit_groups[i]
    } else {
      p_val <- pairwise_pvals_list[[fit_groups[i]]]
      if (length(p_val) == 1 && !is.na(p_val) && p_val > 0) {
        group_labels_with_pval[i] <- paste0(fit_groups[i], format_pval(p_val))
      } else {
        group_labels_with_pval[i] <- fit_groups[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  names(group_labels_with_pval) <- NULL
  
  n_groups <- length(unique(data_plot$surv_group))
  colors <- c("#2E7D32", "#66BB6A", "#FFA726", "#E53935", "#9C27B0", "#00BCD4", "#795548", "#607D8B")[1:n_groups]
  
  ylab_abbrev <- ifelse(ylab == "Progression-Free Survival", "PFS", 
                       ifelse(ylab == "Overall Survival", "OS", ylab))
  
  group_labels_final <- as.character(group_labels_with_pval)
  names(group_labels_final) <- NULL
  
  # Standard KM plot
  # Create Surv object in data frame to avoid scope issues
  data_plot_for_surv <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(
      surv_obj = Surv(surv_time, surv_event)
    )
  
  # Recreate fit with Surv object in data
  fit_with_data <- tryCatch({
    survfit(surv_obj ~ surv_group, data = data_plot_for_surv)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error recreating fit with Surv in data:", e$message, "\n")
    return(fit)  # Fall back to original fit
  })
  
  p <- tryCatch({
    survminer::ggsurvplot(
      fit_with_data,
      data = data_plot_for_surv,
    pval = TRUE,
    pval.size = 4,
    conf.int = FALSE,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    risk.table.height = 0.25,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3.5,
    risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
    risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
    ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
      title = paste0(title, " (Standard)"),
    xlab = "Time (months)",
    ylab = ylab_abbrev,
    legend = "right",
    legend.title = "",
    legend.labs = group_labels_final,
    palette = colors,
    font.main = 12,
    font.x = 10,
    font.y = 10,
    font.tickslab = 9
  )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating ggsurvplot:", e$message, "\n")
    # Try alternative: create plot manually using base R and ggplot2
    tryCatch({
      surv_summary <- summary(fit)
      surv_data <- data.frame(
        time = surv_summary$time,
        surv = surv_summary$surv,
        group = rep(names(surv_summary$strata), surv_summary$strata)
      )
      # This is a fallback - would need more work to match ggsurvplot exactly
      return(NULL)
    }, error = function(e2) {
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  if (!is.null(p) && !is.null(p$plot)) {
    p$plot <- p$plot + 
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  }
  
  # Create IPCW-weighted KM plot
  p_ipcw <- NULL
  cat("\n=== Creating IPCW plot for", title, "===\n")
  if ("ipcw_weight" %in% names(data_plot_ipcw)) {
    cat("IPCW weights found. Creating IPCW-weighted survival plot...\n")
    # Check weight statistics
    weight_stats <- summary(data_plot_ipcw$ipcw_weight)
    cat("IPCW weight statistics for", title, ":\n")
    cat("  Min:", round(weight_stats[1], 3), "Max:", round(weight_stats[6], 3), 
        "Mean:", round(weight_stats[4], 3), "Median:", round(weight_stats[3], 3), "\n")
    
    # For IPCW, we need to create weighted survival curves
    # Use formula directly to avoid scope issues with ggsurvplot
    surv_formula_ipcw <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
    fit_ipcw <- tryCatch({
      cat("Fitting IPCW-weighted survival model...\n")
      fit_result <- survfit(surv_formula_ipcw, data = data_plot_ipcw, weights = data_plot_ipcw$ipcw_weight)
      cat("IPCW survival fit successful. Strata:", length(fit_result$strata), "\n")
      fit_result
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ERROR creating IPCW survival fit:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit_ipcw)) {
      cat("Creating IPCW ggsurvplot...\n")
      # Calculate weighted log-rank test
      pairwise_pvals_ipcw <- list()
      for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
        data_subset_ipcw <- data_plot_ipcw %>%
          filter(surv_group %in% c(reference_group, groups[i]))
        
        if (nrow(data_subset_ipcw) > 0 && sum(data_subset_ipcw$surv_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
          surv_formula_subset_ipcw <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
          logrank_test_ipcw <- tryCatch({
            survdiff(surv_formula_subset_ipcw, data = data_subset_ipcw, 
                     weights = data_subset_ipcw$ipcw_weight)
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (!is.null(logrank_test_ipcw)) {
            p_val_ipcw <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test_ipcw$chisq, length(logrank_test_ipcw$n) - 1)
            pairwise_pvals_ipcw[[groups[i]]] <- p_val_ipcw
          }
        }
      }
      
      group_labels_ipcw <- character(length(fit_groups))
      names(group_labels_ipcw) <- NULL
      
      for (i in seq_along(fit_groups)) {
        if (fit_groups[i] == reference_group) {
          group_labels_ipcw[i] <- fit_groups[i]
        } else {
          p_val_ipcw <- pairwise_pvals_ipcw[[fit_groups[i]]]
          if (length(p_val_ipcw) == 1 && !is.na(p_val_ipcw) && p_val_ipcw > 0) {
            group_labels_ipcw[i] <- paste0(fit_groups[i], format_pval(p_val_ipcw))
          } else {
            group_labels_ipcw[i] <- fit_groups[i]
          }
        }
      }
      
      names(group_labels_ipcw) <- NULL
      
      # Create Surv object in data frame to avoid scope issues
      data_plot_ipcw_for_surv <- data_plot_ipcw %>%
        mutate(
          surv_obj = Surv(surv_time, surv_event)
        )
      
      # Recreate fit with Surv object in data
      fit_ipcw_with_data <- tryCatch({
        survfit(surv_obj ~ surv_group, data = data_plot_ipcw_for_surv, 
                weights = data_plot_ipcw_for_surv$ipcw_weight)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error recreating IPCW fit with Surv in data:", e$message, "\n")
        return(fit_ipcw)  # Fall back to original fit
      })
      
      p_ipcw <- tryCatch({
        plot_result <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
          fit_ipcw_with_data,
          data = data_plot_ipcw_for_surv,
          pval = TRUE,
          pval.size = 4,
          conf.int = FALSE,
          risk.table = TRUE,
          risk.table.height = 0.25,
          risk.table.fontsize = 3.5,
          risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
          risk.table.title = "Number at risk (IPCW-weighted)",
          ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
          title = paste0(title, " (IPCW-Weighted)"),
          xlab = "Time (months)",
          ylab = ylab_abbrev,
          legend = "right",
          legend.title = "",
          legend.labs = group_labels_ipcw,
          palette = colors,
          font.main = 12,
          font.x = 10,
          font.y = 10,
          font.tickslab = 9
        )
        cat("IPCW ggsurvplot created successfully.\n")
        plot_result
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("ERROR creating IPCW ggsurvplot:", e$message, "\n")
        cat("Traceback:\n")
        tryCatch(print(traceback()), error = function(e2) cat("No traceback available\n"))
        return(NULL)
      })
      
      if (!is.null(p_ipcw)) {
        if (!is.null(p_ipcw$plot)) {
          p_ipcw$plot <- p_ipcw$plot + 
            theme(legend.title = element_blank())
          cat("IPCW plot finalized successfully.\n")
        } else {
          cat("WARNING: p_ipcw exists but plot is NULL\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("WARNING: p_ipcw is NULL after ggsurvplot\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("WARNING: fit_ipcw is NULL, cannot create IPCW plot\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("WARNING: ipcw_weight column not found in data_plot_ipcw\n")
    cat("Available columns:", paste(names(data_plot_ipcw), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  cat("=== Finished IPCW plot creation for", title, "===\n\n")
  
  # Perform censoring rate analysis
  data_plot_with_censored <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(censored = 1 - surv_event)
  
  censoring_analysis_rates <- data_plot_with_censored %>%
    group_by(surv_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      n_events = sum(surv_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_censored = sum(censored == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      censoring_rate = mean(censored, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sqrt(censoring_rate * (1 - censoring_rate) / n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Chi-square test for independence of censoring and group
  chi_sq_test <- NULL
  if (nrow(censoring_analysis_rates) > 1 && sum(censoring_analysis_rates$n_censored) > 0 && 
      sum(censoring_analysis_rates$n_events) > 0) {
    censoring_table <- table(data_plot_with_censored$surv_group, data_plot_with_censored$censored)
    chi_sq_test <- tryCatch({
      chisq.test(censoring_table)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis test for censoring times (for censored patients only)
  censored_only <- data_plot_with_censored %>% filter(censored == 1)
  kruskal_test <- NULL
  if (nrow(censored_only) > 0 && length(unique(censored_only$surv_group)) > 1) {
    kruskal_test <- tryCatch({
      kruskal.test(surv_time ~ surv_group, data = censored_only)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  # Final check before returning
  cat("\n=== Final status for", title, "===\n")
  cat("Standard plot created:", !is.null(p), "\n")
  cat("IPCW plot created:", !is.null(p_ipcw), "\n")
  if (!is.null(p_ipcw)) {
    cat("IPCW plot has plot element:", !is.null(p_ipcw$plot), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    plot = p,
    plot_ipcw = p_ipcw,
    cox_model_standard = cox_model_standard,
    cox_model_timedep = cox_model_timedep,
    cox_model_ipcw = cox_model_ipcw,
    model_comparison = model_comparison,
    censoring_analysis = list(
      rates = censoring_analysis_rates,
      chi_square = chi_sq_test,
      kruskal_wallis = kruskal_test
    )
  ))
}

# Create OS plots for each approach with time-dependent models and IPCW
p1_os_fig3 <- NULL
p1_os_fig3_ipcw <- NULL
p2_os_fig3 <- NULL
p2_os_fig3_ipcw <- NULL
p3_os_fig3 <- NULL
p3_os_fig3_ipcw <- NULL
censoring_results_list <- list()
model_comparison_list <- list()

if (exists("survival_qualitative") && nrow(survival_qualitative) > 0 && sum(survival_qualitative$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  result1 <- create_km_plot_timedep(
    survival_qualitative,
    "os_time",
    "death_event",
    "qualitative_group",
    "Qualitative: OS",
    "Overall Survival",
    ctdna_long,
    baseline_ctdna,
    reference_group = "Persistent Negative"
  )
  p1_os_fig3 <- result1$plot
  p1_os_fig3_ipcw <- result1$plot_ipcw
  censoring_results_list[["Qualitative"]] <- result1$censoring_analysis
  if (!is.null(result1$model_comparison) && nrow(result1$model_comparison) > 0) {
    cat("Adding Qualitative model comparison:", nrow(result1$model_comparison), "models\n")
    model_comparison_list[["Qualitative"]] <- result1$model_comparison %>%
      mutate(Approach = "Qualitative")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: Qualitative model_comparison is NULL or empty\n")
  }
}

if (exists("survival_quantitative") && nrow(survival_quantitative) > 0 && sum(survival_quantitative$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  result2 <- create_km_plot_timedep(
    survival_quantitative,
    "os_time",
    "death_event",
    "quantitative_group",
    "Quantitative: OS",
    "Overall Survival",
    ctdna_long,
    baseline_ctdna,
    reference_group = "Persistent Negative"
  )
  p2_os_fig3 <- result2$plot
  p2_os_fig3_ipcw <- result2$plot_ipcw
  censoring_results_list[["Quantitative"]] <- result2$censoring_analysis
  if (!is.null(result2$model_comparison) && nrow(result2$model_comparison) > 0) {
    cat("Adding Quantitative model comparison:", nrow(result2$model_comparison), "models\n")
    model_comparison_list[["Quantitative"]] <- result2$model_comparison %>%
      mutate(Approach = "Quantitative")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: Quantitative model_comparison is NULL or empty\n")
  }
}

if (exists("survival_ml") && nrow(survival_ml) > 0 && sum(survival_ml$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  result3 <- create_km_plot_timedep(
    survival_ml,
    "os_time",
    "death_event",
    "ml_group",
    "ML: OS",
    "Overall Survival",
    ctdna_long,
    baseline_ctdna,
    reference_group = "Persistent Low/Negative ctDNA"
  )
  p3_os_fig3 <- result3$plot
  p3_os_fig3_ipcw <- result3$plot_ipcw
  censoring_results_list[["ML"]] <- result3$censoring_analysis
  if (!is.null(result3$model_comparison) && nrow(result3$model_comparison) > 0) {
    cat("Adding ML model comparison:", nrow(result3$model_comparison), "models\n")
    model_comparison_list[["ML"]] <- result3$model_comparison %>%
      mutate(Approach = "ML")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: ML model_comparison is NULL or empty\n")
  }
}

# Arrange standard plots in grid
plots_list_fig3 <- list()
if (!is.null(p1_os_fig3) && !is.null(p1_os_fig3$plot)) plots_list_fig3[["Qual_OS"]] <- p1_os_fig3$plot
if (!is.null(p2_os_fig3) && !is.null(p2_os_fig3$plot)) plots_list_fig3[["Quant_OS"]] <- p2_os_fig3$plot
if (!is.null(p3_os_fig3) && !is.null(p3_os_fig3$plot)) plots_list_fig3[["ML_OS"]] <- p3_os_fig3$plot

# Arrange IPCW plots in grid
plots_list_fig3_ipcw <- list()
cat("\n=== Checking IPCW plots ===\n")
if (!is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw)) {
  if (!is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw$plot)) {
    plots_list_fig3_ipcw[["Qual_OS_IPCW"]] <- p1_os_fig3_ipcw$plot
    cat("Added Qualitative IPCW plot\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: p1_os_fig3_ipcw exists but plot is NULL\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("p1_os_fig3_ipcw is NULL\n")
}

if (!is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw)) {
  if (!is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw$plot)) {
    plots_list_fig3_ipcw[["Quant_OS_IPCW"]] <- p2_os_fig3_ipcw$plot
    cat("Added Quantitative IPCW plot\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: p2_os_fig3_ipcw exists but plot is NULL\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("p2_os_fig3_ipcw is NULL\n")
}

if (!is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw)) {
  if (!is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw$plot)) {
    plots_list_fig3_ipcw[["ML_OS_IPCW"]] <- p3_os_fig3_ipcw$plot
    cat("Added ML IPCW plot\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: p3_os_fig3_ipcw exists but plot is NULL\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("p3_os_fig3_ipcw is NULL\n")
}
cat("Total IPCW plots collected:", length(plots_list_fig3_ipcw), "\n")

# Print standard plots
if (length(plots_list_fig3) >= 1) {
  if (length(plots_list_fig3) == 1) {
    combined_grid_fig3 <- plots_list_fig3[[1]]
  } else if (length(plots_list_fig3) == 2) {
    combined_grid_fig3 <- plots_list_fig3[[1]] / plots_list_fig3[[2]]
  } else {
    combined_grid_fig3 <- plots_list_fig3[[1]] / plots_list_fig3[[2]] / plots_list_fig3[[3]]
  }
  
  combined_grid_fig3 <- combined_grid_fig3 + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Figure 3a: Overall Survival (OS) by ctDNA Response Criteria (Time-Dependent Cox Models)",
      subtitle = "Qualitative, Quantitative, and ML-based approaches using time-dependent covariates",
      caption = "Time-dependent Cox models account for time-varying ctDNA status. P-value asterisks (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001) indicate pairwise log-rank test comparing each group to the reference group (Persistent Negative/Low ctDNA). Reference group has no asterisks."
    ) &
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, face = "italic"))
  
  invisible(print(combined_grid_fig3))
} else {
  invisible(cat("Insufficient data to create Figure 3a\n"))
}

# Print IPCW-weighted plots
cat("\n=== Creating IPCW plot grid ===\n")
cat("Number of IPCW plots available:", length(plots_list_fig3_ipcw), "\n")

# First, try to print individual IPCW plots if they exist
if (!is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw) && !is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw$plot)) {
  cat("\nPrinting Qualitative IPCW plot individually...\n")
  print(p1_os_fig3_ipcw)
}
if (!is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw) && !is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw$plot)) {
  cat("\nPrinting Quantitative IPCW plot individually...\n")
  print(p2_os_fig3_ipcw)
}
if (!is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw) && !is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw$plot)) {
  cat("\nPrinting ML IPCW plot individually...\n")
  print(p3_os_fig3_ipcw)
}

# Then try to combine them
if (length(plots_list_fig3_ipcw) >= 1) {
  cat("\nCreating combined IPCW plot with", length(plots_list_fig3_ipcw), "plots\n")
  tryCatch({
    if (length(plots_list_fig3_ipcw) == 1) {
      combined_grid_fig3_ipcw <- plots_list_fig3_ipcw[[1]]
    } else if (length(plots_list_fig3_ipcw) == 2) {
      combined_grid_fig3_ipcw <- plots_list_fig3_ipcw[[1]] / plots_list_fig3_ipcw[[2]]
    } else {
      combined_grid_fig3_ipcw <- plots_list_fig3_ipcw[[1]] / plots_list_fig3_ipcw[[2]] / plots_list_fig3_ipcw[[3]]
    }
    
    combined_grid_fig3_ipcw <- combined_grid_fig3_ipcw + 
      plot_annotation(
        title = "Figure 3b: Overall Survival (OS) by ctDNA Response Criteria (IPCW-Weighted)",
        subtitle = "Inverse Probability of Censoring Weighting to account for informative censoring",
        caption = "IPCW weights adjust for differential censoring rates between groups. P-value asterisks (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001) indicate weighted log-rank test."
      ) &
      theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, face = "italic"))
    
    print(combined_grid_fig3_ipcw)
    cat("IPCW combined plot printed successfully\n\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error combining IPCW plots:", e$message, "\n")
    cat("Individual plots were printed above.\n\n")
  })
} else {
  cat("\nWARNING: Insufficient data to create Figure 3b (IPCW-weighted). No IPCW plots were created.\n")
  cat("This may occur if:\n")
  cat("  1. IPCW weights could not be calculated\n")
  cat("  2. All IPCW weights are equal to 1 (no differential censoring)\n")
  cat("  3. Survival fits failed for IPCW-weighted data\n")
  cat("  4. ggsurvplot failed to create the plots\n\n")
  
  # Debug: Check what we actually have
  cat("Debug information:\n")
  cat("  p1_os_fig3_ipcw is NULL:", is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw), "\n")
  if (!is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw)) {
    cat("  p1_os_fig3_ipcw$plot is NULL:", is.null(p1_os_fig3_ipcw$plot), "\n")
  }
  cat("  p2_os_fig3_ipcw is NULL:", is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw), "\n")
  if (!is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw)) {
    cat("  p2_os_fig3_ipcw$plot is NULL:", is.null(p2_os_fig3_ipcw$plot), "\n")
  }
  cat("  p3_os_fig3_ipcw is NULL:", is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw), "\n")
  if (!is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw)) {
    cat("  p3_os_fig3_ipcw$plot is NULL:", is.null(p3_os_fig3_ipcw$plot), "\n")
  }
}

# Print model performance comparison
cat("\n\n## Model Performance Comparison\n\n")

if (length(model_comparison_list) > 0) {
  # Format C-index with CI
  model_comparison_all <- bind_rows(model_comparison_list) %>%
    mutate(
      C_Index_Formatted = ifelse(
        !is.na(C_Index_CI_Lower) & !is.na(C_Index_CI_Upper),
        paste0(round(C_Index, 3), " (", round(C_Index_CI_Lower, 3), "-", round(C_Index_CI_Upper, 3), ")"),
        ifelse(!is.na(C_Index), as.character(round(C_Index, 3)), "N/A")
      ),
      AIC = round(AIC, 1)
    ) %>%
    select(Approach, Model, C_Index_Formatted, AIC, N) %>%
    rename(`C-Index (95% CI)` = C_Index_Formatted) %>%
    arrange(Approach, Model)
  
  # Create and display Table 3b
  table_3b <- model_comparison_all %>%
    kable(caption = "Table 3b: Model Performance Comparison (C-Index with 95% CI and AIC)",
          align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = TRUE, font_size = 10) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    add_footnote(c("C-Index: Harrell's concordance index (higher is better, 0.5 = random, 1.0 = perfect)",
                   "95% CI calculated using asymptotic standard error or bootstrap (200 iterations if SE unavailable)",
                   "AIC: Akaike Information Criterion (lower is better)",
                   "Time-Dependent Cox accounts for time-varying ctDNA status",
                   "IPCW-Weighted Cox adjusts for informative censoring"), 
                 notation = "symbol")
  
  # Explicitly display the table - must be last expression
  table_3b
  
  # Side-by-side comparison table removed - Table 3b provides sufficient detail
  
  # Create pairwise comparison table
  pairwise_comparisons <- list()
  for (approach_name in names(model_comparison_list)) {
    comp_data <- model_comparison_list[[approach_name]]
    if (nrow(comp_data) >= 2) {
      models <- comp_data$Model
      for (i in 1:(length(models) - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):length(models)) {
          model1 <- models[i]
          model2 <- models[j]
          c1 <- comp_data$C_Index[comp_data$Model == model1]
          c2 <- comp_data$C_Index[comp_data$Model == model2]
          ci1_lower <- comp_data$C_Index_CI_Lower[comp_data$Model == model1]
          ci1_upper <- comp_data$C_Index_CI_Upper[comp_data$Model == model1]
          ci2_lower <- comp_data$C_Index_CI_Lower[comp_data$Model == model2]
          ci2_upper <- comp_data$C_Index_CI_Upper[comp_data$Model == model2]
          
          if (!is.na(c1) && !is.na(c2)) {
            diff <- c1 - c2
            # Approximate SE of difference using CI widths
            se1 <- ifelse(!is.na(ci1_lower) && !is.na(ci1_upper), 
                         abs(ci1_upper - ci1_lower) / (2 * 1.96), 
                         ifelse(!is.na(c1), 0.05, NA_real_))
            se2 <- ifelse(!is.na(ci2_lower) && !is.na(ci2_upper), 
                         abs(ci2_upper - ci2_lower) / (2 * 1.96), 
                         ifelse(!is.na(c2), 0.05, NA_real_))
            
            if (is.na(se1)) se1 <- 0.05
            if (is.na(se2)) se2 <- 0.05
            
            se_diff <- sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2)
            if (se_diff > 0) {
              z_score <- diff / se_diff
              p_val <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score)))
            } else {
              p_val <- NA_real_
            }
            
            pairwise_comparisons[[length(pairwise_comparisons) + 1]] <- tibble(
              Approach = approach_name,
              Comparison = paste0(model1, " vs ", model2),
              `C-Index Difference` = round(diff, 3),
              `P-value` = ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_val, 3))
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(pairwise_comparisons) > 0) {
    pairwise_table <- bind_rows(pairwise_comparisons)
    # Create and display Table 3c
    table_3c <- pairwise_table %>%
      kable(caption = "Table 3c: Pairwise Model Comparison (C-Index Differences)",
            align = "l") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                    full_width = TRUE, font_size = 10) %>%
      column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
      add_footnote("P-values test the null hypothesis that C-index difference = 0. Calculated using approximate z-test based on bootstrap CIs.", 
                   notation = "none")
    # Explicitly display the table - must be last expression
    table_3c
  } else {
    cat("\nNote: Pairwise comparisons require at least 2 models per approach.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Model comparison data not available.\n\n")
}

# Print censoring analysis results
cat("\n=== CENSORING RATE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat("Testing for non-informative censoring assumption across ctDNA groups\n")
cat("Note: If censoring is informative (p < 0.05), IPCW-weighted analysis is recommended.\n\n")

# Create summary table of censoring rates
censoring_summary_list <- list()
for (approach_name in names(censoring_results_list)) {
  cens_analysis <- censoring_results_list[[approach_name]]
  if (!is.null(cens_analysis$rates)) {
    cens_summary <- cens_analysis$rates %>%
      mutate(
        Approach = approach_name,
        `Chi-square P-value` = ifelse(!is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square) && 
                                      !is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value),
                                      round(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value, 4),
                                      NA_real_),
        `Interpretation` = ifelse(!is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square) && 
                                  !is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value) &&
                                  cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value < 0.05,
                                  "⚠️ Potentially informative",
                                  "✓ Non-informative likely")
      ) %>%
      select(Approach, Group = surv_group, N = n, `N Events` = n_events, 
             `N Censored` = n_censored, `Censoring Rate` = censoring_rate,
             `Chi-square P-value`, Interpretation)
    censoring_summary_list[[approach_name]] <- cens_summary
  }
}

if (length(censoring_summary_list) > 0) {
  censoring_summary_all <- bind_rows(censoring_summary_list) %>%
    mutate(
      `Censoring Rate` = round(`Censoring Rate` * 100, 1),
      `Censoring Rate` = paste0(`Censoring Rate`, "%")
    )
  
  # Create and display Table 3a
  table_3a <- kable(censoring_summary_all,
        caption = "Table 3a: Censoring Rate Analysis by ctDNA Group",
        align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = TRUE, font_size = 10) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
  
  # Explicitly display the table - must be last expression
  table_3a
  
  cat("\nDetailed test results:\n")
  for (approach_name in names(censoring_results_list)) {
    cat("\n---", approach_name, "Groups ---\n")
    cens_analysis <- censoring_results_list[[approach_name]]
    if (!is.null(cens_analysis$rates)) {
      print(cens_analysis$rates)
    }
    if (!is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square)) {
      cat("\nChi-square test for independence of censoring and group:\n")
      print(cens_analysis$chi_square)
      if (!is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value) && cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value < 0.05) {
        cat("⚠️  WARNING: Censoring may be informative (p =", round(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value, 4), ")\n")
        cat("   This suggests that censoring rates differ significantly between groups.\n")
        cat("   Consider sensitivity analyses or competing risks models.\n")
      } else {
        cat("✓ Censoring appears non-informative (p =", 
            ifelse(is.null(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value), "N/A", 
                   round(cens_analysis$chi_square$p.value, 4)), ")\n")
        cat("   This supports the assumption that censoring is independent of group status.\n")
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(cens_analysis$kruskal_wallis)) {
      cat("\nKruskal-Wallis test for differences in censoring times:\n")
      print(cens_analysis$kruskal_wallis)
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("No censoring analysis results available.\n")
}
```

```{r research_questions_universes, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Research Questions - Universe Calculations
# NOTE: This section has been removed from the descriptive analysis.
# Question-specific analyses (Ruveyda/Anna/Lydia/Thomas) are now handled
# in dedicated question-specific R Markdown files.
# ==============================

# Question 1: Ruveyda's Question
# "What is the association of on-treatment clinical events (e.g., AKI, hydronephrosis, transfusions) 
#  and non-reported pre-treatment factors (e.g., uncontrolled cardiac disease) on ctDNA profiles and clearance patterns?"
# Universe: Patients who underwent cystectomy, n = ?

# Extract cystectomy information
# Look for surgery type columns that indicate cystectomy
surgery_type_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("surgery.*type|surgery.*procedure|surgery_\\d+_type|surgery_\\d+_procedure", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Get patients who underwent cystectomy
if (length(surgery_type_cols) > 0 && length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
  cystectomy_patients <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(surgery_type_cols), all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(surgery_type_cols), names_to = "surgery_type_var", values_to = "surgery_type") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(surgery_date_cols), names_to = "surgery_date_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      surgery_type = as.character(surgery_type),
      surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
      is_cystectomy = str_detect(tolower(surgery_type), "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy")
    ) %>%
    filter(is_cystectomy, !is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
    distinct(patient_id) %>%
    pull(patient_id)
  
  n_cystectomy <- length(cystectomy_patients)
} else {
  # Fallback: assume surgery_1_date is cystectomy if no type column
  if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
    cystectomy_patients <- dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(surgery_date_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(surgery_date_raw = all_of(surgery_date_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
      pull(patient_id)
    
    n_cystectomy <- length(cystectomy_patients)
  } else {
    cystectomy_patients <- character(0)
    n_cystectomy <- 0
  }
}

# Question 2: Anna's Question
# "Can a case series of patients with undetectable ctDNA following TURBT (without additional therapy) 
#  help isolate and quantify the therapeutic impact of TURBT alone in MIBC?"
# Universe: Patients who underwent TURBT alone and had undetectable ctDNA afterwards, n = ?

# Approach: Identify patients by ctDNA clearance pattern (detectable to undetectable)
# and exclude those with cystectomy or systemic therapy that started before clearance
# This captures patients who had TURBT (even if not explicitly recorded) and had ctDNA clearance

# Build ctDNA long data if not already available
if (!exists("ctdna_long") || is.null(ctdna_long) || nrow(ctdna_long) == 0) {
  ctdna_long_local <- build_ctdna_long(dat_combined, "patient_id") %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))
} else {
  ctdna_long_local <- ctdna_long %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))
}

if (nrow(ctdna_long_local) > 0) {
  # Find patients with ctDNA clearance (detectable to undetectable)
  patients_with_clearance <- ctdna_long_local %>%
    arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      first_detectable_date = if (any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        min(ctdna_date[ctdna_value > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      first_undetectable_date = if (any(ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        min(ctdna_date[ctdna_value == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Clearance pattern: had detectable, then undetectable after
      had_clearance_pattern = !is.na(first_detectable_date) & 
                             !is.na(first_undetectable_date) &
                             first_undetectable_date > first_detectable_date
    ) %>%
    filter(had_clearance_pattern) %>%
    pull(patient_id)
  
  # Exclude patients with cystectomy
  if (length(surgery_type_cols) > 0 && length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
    patients_with_cystectomy <- dat_combined %>%
      mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(surgery_type_cols), all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(surgery_type_cols), names_to = "surgery_type_var", values_to = "surgery_type") %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(surgery_date_cols), names_to = "surgery_date_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        surgery_type = as.character(surgery_type),
        surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
        is_cystectomy = str_detect(tolower(surgery_type), "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy")
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_date), is_cystectomy) %>%
      distinct(patient_id) %>%
      pull(patient_id)
  } else {
    patients_with_cystectomy <- character(0)
  }
  
  # Calculate when ctDNA became undetectable for each patient
  # This is the first undetectable date after the first detectable date
  clearance_dates <- ctdna_long_local %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% patients_with_clearance) %>%
    arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      first_detectable_date = if (any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        min(ctdna_date[ctdna_value > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Now find first undetectable after first detectable
    left_join(
      ctdna_long_local %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% patients_with_clearance) %>%
        select(patient_id, ctdna_date, ctdna_value),
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(first_detectable_date),
      ctdna_value == 0,
      ctdna_date > first_detectable_date
    ) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      clearance_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(clearance_date))
  
  # Exclude patients with systemic therapy that started less than 1 year after ctDNA became undetectable
  therapy_start_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  patients_with_therapy_too_soon <- character(0)
  if (length(therapy_start_cols) > 0 && nrow(clearance_dates) > 0) {
    therapy_dates <- dat_combined %>%
      mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% clearance_dates$patient_id) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "therapy_start_raw") %>%
      mutate(therapy_start = as_date_safe(therapy_start_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_start)) %>%
      left_join(clearance_dates %>% select(patient_id, clearance_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(clearance_date),
        # Exclude if therapy started less than 1 year (365 days) after clearance
        as.numeric(therapy_start - clearance_date) < 365
      ) %>%
      distinct(patient_id) %>%
      pull(patient_id)
    patients_with_therapy_too_soon <- therapy_dates
  }
  
  # Exclude patients with radiation that started less than 1 year after ctDNA became undetectable
  # Also exclude if radiation started before clearance (would interfere with TURBT effect)
  radiation_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation|rt|radiotherapy|radiation.*therapy|radiation.*treatment", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  patients_with_radiation_too_soon <- character(0)
  if (length(radiation_cols) > 0 && nrow(clearance_dates) > 0) {
    # Check for radiation date columns
    radiation_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*date|rt.*date|radiotherapy.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(radiation_date_cols) > 0) {
      radiation_dates <- dat_combined %>%
        mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% clearance_dates$patient_id) %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_date_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "radiation_date_raw") %>%
        mutate(radiation_date = as_date_safe(radiation_date_raw)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(radiation_date)) %>%
        left_join(clearance_dates %>% select(patient_id, clearance_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(clearance_date),
          # Exclude if radiation started before clearance OR less than 1 year (365 days) after clearance
          radiation_date < clearance_date | as.numeric(radiation_date - clearance_date) < 365
        ) %>%
        distinct(patient_id) %>%
        pull(patient_id)
      patients_with_radiation_too_soon <- unique(c(patients_with_radiation_too_soon, radiation_dates))
      
      # Also check for patients with radiation marked as "yes" but no valid date found
      # These should also be excluded (conservative approach)
      patients_with_radiation_but_no_date <- dat_combined %>%
        mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% clearance_dates$patient_id) %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_date_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "radiation_date_raw") %>%
        mutate(radiation_date = as_date_safe(radiation_date_raw)) %>%
        group_by(patient_id) %>%
        summarise(has_valid_date = any(!is.na(radiation_date)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        filter(!has_valid_date) %>%
        pull(patient_id)
    }
    
    # Check for radiation yes/no columns - if yes, exclude (conservative)
    # This catches cases where radiation is marked as yes but date is missing or invalid
    radiation_yesno_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*yes.*no|rt.*yes.*no|radiotherapy.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(radiation_yesno_cols) > 0) {
      # If radiation is marked as yes, exclude them (conservative approach)
      # Without a valid date, we can't verify it was >1 year after clearance
      patients_with_radiation_yes <- dat_combined %>%
        mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% clearance_dates$patient_id) %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_yesno_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "radiation_yesno") %>%
        mutate(
          radiation_yesno_lower = tolower(as.character(radiation_yesno)),
          has_radiation = str_detect(radiation_yesno_lower, "yes|y|1|true")
        ) %>%
        filter(has_radiation) %>%
        distinct(patient_id) %>%
        pull(patient_id)
      patients_with_radiation_too_soon <- unique(c(patients_with_radiation_too_soon, patients_with_radiation_yes))
    }
    
    # Also include patients with radiation but no valid date
    if (exists("patients_with_radiation_but_no_date")) {
      patients_with_radiation_too_soon <- unique(c(patients_with_radiation_too_soon, patients_with_radiation_but_no_date))
    }
  }
  
  # Final list: patients with clearance, no cystectomy, no therapy/radiation within 1 year of clearance
  turbt_undetectable <- setdiff(
    setdiff(
      setdiff(patients_with_clearance, patients_with_cystectomy),
      patients_with_therapy_too_soon
    ),
    patients_with_radiation_too_soon
  )
  
  n_turbt_undetectable <- length(turbt_undetectable)
} else {
  turbt_undetectable <- character(0)
  n_turbt_undetectable <- 0
}

# Question 3: Lydia's Question
# "Do ctDNA detection thresholds or kinetic profiles differ between organ-confined (loco-regional) vs metastatic recurrence? 
#  Specifically, is there a threshold level (or kinetic finding) for ctDNA levels prior to cystectomy that correlates to higher risk for metastatic disease? 
#  How is ctDNA level associated with time to recurrence?"
# Universe: Patients who underwent cystectomy and had ctDNA levels available beforehand, n = ?

if (exists("cystectomy_patients") && length(cystectomy_patients) > 0 && exists("ctdna_long")) {
  # Get cystectomy dates
  if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
    cystectomy_dates <- dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% cystectomy_patients) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(cystectomy_date = min(surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    
    # Get patients with ctDNA before cystectomy
    patients_ctdna_before_cyst <- ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(cystectomy_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(cystectomy_date),
        ctdna_date < cystectomy_date,
        !is.na(ctdna_value)
      ) %>%
      distinct(patient_id) %>%
      pull(patient_id)
    
    n_ctdna_before_cyst <- length(patients_ctdna_before_cyst)
  } else {
    n_ctdna_before_cyst <- 0
  }
} else {
  n_ctdna_before_cyst <- 0
}

# Question 4: Thomas's Question
# "What are the long-term clinical outcomes of patients with persistently low-level detectable ctDNA over extended follow-up periods? 
#  Did many of these patients receive immunotherapy?"
# Universe: Patients who underwent cystectomy and had persistently low-level detectable ctDNA over extended follow-up periods, n = ?

# Define "persistently low-level detectable" as:
# - Baseline ctDNA > 0 but relatively low (e.g., < 10 or < median)
# - Multiple measurements showing detectable ctDNA
# - Extended follow-up (e.g., > 6 months or > median follow-up)

if (exists("cystectomy_patients") && length(cystectomy_patients) > 0 && exists("ctdna_long")) {
  # Get baseline ctDNA if available
  if (exists("baseline_ctdna")) {
    baseline_ctdna_local <- baseline_ctdna
  } else {
    # Calculate baseline from ctdna_long
    baseline_ctdna_local <- ctdna_long %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(patient_id, baseline_value = ctdna_value, baseline_date = ctdna_date)
  }
  
  # Get follow-up duration from survival outcomes if available
  if (exists("survival_outcomes")) {
    # Calculate follow-up duration for cystectomy patients
    cyst_fu <- survival_outcomes %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% cystectomy_patients) %>%
      mutate(
        fu_duration_months = ifelse(!is.na(os_time), os_time, NA_real_)
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, fu_duration_months)
    
    # Get patients with persistently low-level detectable ctDNA
    # Criteria: baseline > 0 but < threshold, multiple positive measurements, extended follow-up
    median_baseline <- median(baseline_ctdna_local$baseline_value[baseline_ctdna_local$baseline_value > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    median_fu <- median(cyst_fu$fu_duration_months, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Store definition parameters for display
    persistent_low_definition <- NA_character_
    
    if (is.finite(median_baseline) && is.finite(median_fu) && median_fu > 0) {
      persistent_low <- ctdna_long %>%
        left_join(baseline_ctdna_local, by = "patient_id") %>%
        left_join(cyst_fu, by = "patient_id") %>%
        filter(
          patient_id %in% cystectomy_patients,
          !is.na(baseline_value),
          baseline_value > 0,
          baseline_value < median_baseline,  # Low-level
          !is.na(fu_duration_months),
          fu_duration_months > median_fu  # Extended follow-up
        ) %>%
        group_by(patient_id) %>%
        summarise(
          n_positive = sum(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
          n_measurements = n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        filter(
          n_positive >= 2,  # Multiple positive measurements
          n_measurements >= 3  # Multiple measurements overall
        ) %>%
        pull(patient_id)
      
      n_persistent_low <- length(persistent_low)
      
      # Create definition string
      persistent_low_definition <- paste0(
        "Baseline ctDNA > 0 and < ", round(median_baseline, 2), 
        " (median); Follow-up > ", round(median_fu, 1), " months (median); ",
        "≥2 positive measurements; ≥3 total measurements"
      )
    } else {
      persistent_low <- character(0)
      persistent_low_definition <- "Criteria not met (insufficient data for median calculations)"
      n_persistent_low <- 0
    }
  } else {
    persistent_low <- character(0)
    persistent_low_definition <- "Criteria not met (no follow-up data available)"
    n_persistent_low <- 0
  }
} else {
  persistent_low <- character(0)
  persistent_low_definition <- "Criteria not met (no cystectomy patients or ctDNA data)"
  n_persistent_low <- 0
}

# Ensure definition exists
if (!exists("persistent_low_definition") || is.na(persistent_low_definition)) {
  persistent_low_definition <- "Definition not available"
}

# Create summary table
questions_summary <- tibble(
  Question = c(
    "Ruveyda: Association of on-treatment clinical events and pre-treatment factors on ctDNA profiles",
    "Anna: Case series of patients with undetectable ctDNA following TURBT alone",
    "Lydia: ctDNA thresholds/kinetics for organ-confined vs metastatic recurrence",
    "Thomas: Long-term outcomes of persistently low-level detectable ctDNA"
  ),
  Universe = c(
    "Patients who underwent cystectomy",
    "Patients who underwent TURBT alone and had undetectable ctDNA afterwards without cancer directed therapy",
    "Patients who underwent cystectomy and had ctDNA levels available beforehand",
    "Patients who underwent cystectomy and had persistently low-level detectable ctDNA over extended follow-up"
  ),
  `N` = c(n_cystectomy, n_turbt_undetectable, n_ctdna_before_cyst, n_persistent_low),
  `Patient IDs` = c(
    NA_character_,  # Ruveyda - no IDs needed
    if (length(turbt_undetectable) > 0) paste(sort(turbt_undetectable), collapse = ", ") else "None",
    NA_character_,  # Lydia - no IDs needed
    if (length(persistent_low) > 0) paste(sort(persistent_low), collapse = ", ") else "None"
  ),
  `Definition` = c(
    NA_character_,  # Ruveyda - no definition needed
    NA_character_,  # Anna - no definition needed
    NA_character_,  # Lydia - no definition needed
    persistent_low_definition  # Thomas - show definition
  )
)

kable(questions_summary, 
      caption = "Research Questions - Universe Calculations",
      col.names = c("Question", "Universe", "N", "Patient IDs", "Definition")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r research_questions_swimmer_plots, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, out.width="100%"}
# ==============================
# Research Questions Swimmer Plots
# NOTE: This section has been removed from the descriptive analysis.
# Question-specific swimmer plots are now generated in dedicated
# question-specific R Markdown files.
# ==============================

# Check if required variables exist
if (!exists("dat_combined") || !exists("ctdna_long")) {
  stop("Required variables 'dat_combined' and 'ctdna_long' not found. Please run all previous chunks first.")
}

# Helper function to create swimmer plot for a set of patients
create_research_question_swimmer <- function(patient_ids, title, id_col_name = "patient_id") {
  if (length(patient_ids) == 0 || !exists("dat_combined") || !exists("ctdna_long")) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Convert patient_ids to character for consistent matching
  patient_ids_char <- as.character(patient_ids)
  
  # Ensure dat_combined has patient_id as character
  # First check if patient_id exists, if not try to find ID column
  if (!"patient_id" %in% names(dat_combined)) {
    # Try to find the ID column
    id_candidates <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("patient.*id|record.*id|id.*linking", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(id_candidates) > 0) {
      id_col_to_use <- id_candidates[1]
      dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
        mutate(patient_id = as.character(.data[[id_col_to_use]]))
    } else if (id_col_name %in% names(dat_combined)) {
      dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
        mutate(patient_id = as.character(.data[[id_col_name]]))
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  } else {
    dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
      mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))
  }
  
  # Filter to patients in this question
  patients_data <- dat_combined %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% patient_ids_char)
  
  if (nrow(patients_data) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get first known event (minimum of first ctDNA, first therapy, or follow-up start)
  # Ensure ctdna_long has patient_id as character
  ctdna_long_char <- ctdna_long %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))
  
  first_ctdna_dates <- ctdna_long_char %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% patient_ids_char) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Get first therapy start dates
  therapy_start_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  first_therapy_dates <- if (length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
    dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_ids_char) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "therapy_start_raw") %>%
      mutate(therapy_start = as_date_safe(therapy_start_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_start)) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(first_therapy_date = min(therapy_start, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    tibble(patient_id = character(0), first_therapy_date = as.Date(character(0)))
  }
  
  # Get follow-up start dates
  follow_up_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                        !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  follow_up_dates <- if (length(follow_up_cols) > 0) {
    dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_ids_char) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(follow_up_date_raw = all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(follow_up_date = as_date_safe(follow_up_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(follow_up_date)) %>%
      select(patient_id, follow_up_date)
  } else {
    tibble(patient_id = character(0), follow_up_date = as.Date(character(0)))
  }
  
  # Calculate first known event per patient
  patient_timeline <- patients_data %>%
    select(patient_id) %>%
    left_join(first_ctdna_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
    left_join(first_therapy_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
    left_join(follow_up_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      first_known_event = min(c(first_ctdna_date, first_therapy_date, follow_up_date), na.rm = TRUE),
      time_anchor = coalesce(follow_up_date, first_ctdna_date, first_therapy_date),
      # If no first_known_event, use time_anchor as fallback
      first_known_event = ifelse(is.na(first_known_event) | is.infinite(first_known_event), 
                                time_anchor, first_known_event),
      follow_up_interval_days = if (!is.na(time_anchor) && !is.na(first_known_event)) {
        as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      follow_up_interval_months = follow_up_interval_days / 30.44
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Only filter out if we truly have no anchor point
    filter(!is.na(time_anchor))
  
  if (nrow(patient_timeline) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # If first_known_event is still NA, set it to time_anchor
  patient_timeline <- patient_timeline %>%
    mutate(
      first_known_event = ifelse(is.na(first_known_event) | is.infinite(first_known_event),
                                time_anchor, first_known_event),
      follow_up_interval_months = ifelse(is.na(follow_up_interval_months) | is.infinite(follow_up_interval_months),
                                        0, follow_up_interval_months)
    )
  
  # Get ctDNA data
  plot_ctdna <- ctdna_long_char %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(patient_id, time_anchor, first_known_event), by = "patient_id") %>%
    mutate(
      months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      ctdna_detectable = ctdna_value > 0
    )
  
  # Get therapy periods - build from dat_combined
  therapy_periods <- if (length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
    # Get therapy start dates
    therapy_start_data <- dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+")),
        start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_idx, start_date)
    
    # Get therapy end dates
    therapy_end_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*end.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    therapy_end_data <- if (length(therapy_end_cols) > 0) {
      dat_combined %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_end_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "end_date_raw") %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+")),
          end_date = as_date_safe(end_date_raw)
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(end_date)) %>%
        select(patient_id, therapy_idx, end_date)
    } else {
      tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_idx = integer(0), end_date = as.Date(character(0)))
    }
    
    # Get therapy settings
    therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    therapy_setting_data <- if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
      dat_combined %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
        pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+")),
          setting_clean = case_when(
            str_detect(tolower(setting_raw), "neoadjuvant|neo.*adjuvant") ~ "Neoadjuvant",
            str_detect(tolower(setting_raw), "adjuvant") & !str_detect(tolower(setting_raw), "neo") ~ "Adjuvant",
            str_detect(tolower(setting_raw), "palliative") ~ "Palliative",
            TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
          )
        ) %>%
        select(patient_id, therapy_idx, setting_clean)
    } else {
      tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_idx = integer(0), setting_clean = character(0))
    }
    
    # Combine therapy data
    therapy_periods <- therapy_start_data %>%
      left_join(therapy_end_data, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_idx")) %>%
      left_join(therapy_setting_data, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_idx")) %>%
      inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(patient_id, first_known_event, follow_up_interval_months), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(
        start_months = as.numeric(start_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
        end_months = case_when(
          !is.na(end_date) ~ as.numeric(end_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        setting_label = case_when(
          setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
          setting_clean == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
          setting_clean == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
          is.na(setting_clean) | setting_clean == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
          TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
        ),
        end_months_final = ifelse(is.na(end_months), follow_up_interval_months, end_months)
      )
  } else {
    tibble()
  }
  
  # Get surgery dates
  surgery_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  plot_surgery <- if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
    dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
      inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(patient_id, first_known_event), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(surgery_months = as.numeric(surgery_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  # Get radiation dates
  radiation_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*date|rt.*date|radiotherapy.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  plot_radiation <- if (length(radiation_date_cols) > 0) {
    dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_date_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "radiation_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(radiation_date = as_date_safe(radiation_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(radiation_date)) %>%
      inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(patient_id, first_known_event), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(rad_months = as.numeric(radiation_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  # Get relapse dates
  relapse_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  plot_relapse <- if (length(relapse_cols) > 0) {
    dat_combined %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(relapse_date_raw = all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(relapse_date)) %>%
      inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(patient_id, first_known_event), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(relapse_months = as.numeric(relapse_date - first_known_event) / 30.44)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  # Get death dates from survival_outcomes
  plot_death <- if (exists("survival_outcomes")) {
    survival_outcomes %>%
      mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% patient_timeline$patient_id) %>%
      filter(death_status_final == 1, !is.na(death_date)) %>%
      inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(patient_id, first_known_event), by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(death_months = as.numeric(death_date - first_known_event) / 30.44)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  # Order patients
  patient_order <- patient_timeline %>%
    arrange(patient_id) %>%
    pull(patient_id)
  
  patient_timeline <- patient_timeline %>%
    mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  
  # Update all data frames to use patient_id_ordered
  plot_ctdna <- plot_ctdna %>%
    mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  
  if (nrow(therapy_periods) > 0) {
    therapy_periods <- therapy_periods %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(plot_surgery) && nrow(plot_surgery) > 0) {
    plot_surgery <- plot_surgery %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(plot_radiation) && nrow(plot_radiation) > 0) {
    plot_radiation <- plot_radiation %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(plot_relapse) && nrow(plot_relapse) > 0) {
    plot_relapse <- plot_relapse %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(plot_death) && nrow(plot_death) > 0) {
    plot_death <- plot_death %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order))
  }
  
  # Calculate x-axis limits
  x_min_data <- c(
    if (nrow(therapy_periods) > 0) therapy_periods$start_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_surgery) && nrow(plot_surgery) > 0) plot_surgery$surgery_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_radiation) && nrow(plot_radiation) > 0) plot_radiation$rad_months else NULL,
    plot_ctdna$months_from_anchor
  )
  x_max_data <- c(
    patient_timeline$follow_up_interval_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_relapse) && nrow(plot_relapse) > 0) plot_relapse$relapse_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_death) && nrow(plot_death) > 0) plot_death$death_months else NULL,
    if (nrow(therapy_periods) > 0) therapy_periods$end_months_final else NULL
  )
  x_min <- floor(min(x_min_data, na.rm = TRUE)) - 3
  x_max <- ceiling(max(x_max_data, na.rm = TRUE)) + 3
  x_min <- max(x_min, -12)
  x_breaks <- seq(floor(x_min / 6) * 6, ceiling(x_max / 6) * 6, by = 6)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Per-patient follow-up interval bars
    geom_segment(
      data = patient_timeline,
      aes(x = 0, xend = follow_up_interval_months,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered),
      linewidth = 3, color = "gray85", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    # Therapy period bars (color by setting)
    {if (nrow(therapy_periods) > 0) {
      geom_segment(
        data = therapy_periods,
        aes(x = start_months, 
            xend = end_months_final,
            y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered,
            color = setting_label),
        linewidth = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, lineend = "round"
      )
    }} +
    # ctDNA positive markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna %>% filter(ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # ctDNA negative markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna %>% filter(!ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # Surgery events
    {if (!is.null(plot_surgery) && nrow(plot_surgery) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_surgery,
        aes(x = surgery_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue"
      )
    }} +
    # Radiation events
    {if (!is.null(plot_radiation) && nrow(plot_radiation) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_radiation,
        aes(x = rad_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange"
      )
    }} +
    # Metastatic relapse events
    {if (!is.null(plot_relapse) && nrow(plot_relapse) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_relapse,
        aes(x = relapse_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2
      )
    }} +
    # Death events
    {if (!is.null(plot_death) && nrow(plot_death) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_death,
        aes(x = death_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 4, shape = 8, color = "black", stroke = 1.5
      )
    }} +
    # Vertical line at anchor (time anchor = 0)
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Color scales for therapy setting
    {if (nrow(therapy_periods) > 0) {
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "Neoadjuvant" = "#4E79A7",
          "Adjuvant" = "#59A14F",
          "Palliative" = "#9C755F",
          "Clinical trial" = "#F28E2B"
        ),
        guide = "none"
      )
    }} +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(patient_timeline$patient_id_ordered)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Time from First Known Event (months)",
      y = "Patient ID"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(l = 10, r = 8, t = 8, b = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0.02, 0))
  
  return(p)
}

# Plot 1: Anna's Question - TURBT alone with undetectable ctDNA
p_anna <- NULL
if (exists("turbt_undetectable") && length(turbt_undetectable) > 0) {
  # Ensure patient IDs are character
  anna_patients <- as.character(turbt_undetectable)
  cat("Anna's question: Found", length(anna_patients), "patients\n")
  p_anna <- create_research_question_swimmer(
    anna_patients,
    paste0("Anna's Question: TURBT Alone with Undetectable ctDNA (n = ", length(anna_patients), ")")
  )
  if (is.null(p_anna)) {
    cat("Plot creation returned NULL for Anna's question.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No patients found for Anna's question.\n")
  if (!exists("turbt_undetectable")) {
    cat("Variable 'turbt_undetectable' does not exist. Please run the 'research_questions_universes' chunk first.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Variable 'turbt_undetectable' exists but has length:", length(turbt_undetectable), "\n")
  }
}

# Create legend plot
legend_plot_research <- ggplot() +
  # ctDNA positive
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.9, label = "ctDNA+", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # ctDNA negative
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.8, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.8, label = "ctDNA-", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Surgery
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.7, size = 4, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.7, label = "Surgery", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Radiation
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.6, size = 4, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.6, label = "Radiation", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Relapse
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.5, size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.5, label = "Metastatic relapse", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Death
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.4, size = 4, shape = 8, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.4, label = "Death", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Therapy settings - Neoadjuvant
  annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.3, yend = 0.3, linewidth = 4, color = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.3, label = "Neoadjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Therapy settings - Adjuvant
  annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.2, yend = 0.2, linewidth = 4, color = "#59A14F", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.2, label = "Adjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Therapy settings - Palliative
  annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.1, yend = 0.1, linewidth = 4, color = "#9C755F", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.1, label = "Palliative", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  # Therapy settings - Clinical trial
  annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.0, yend = 0.0, linewidth = 4, color = "#F28E2B", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.0, label = "Clinical trial", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# Combine plots with legend
plots_list_research <- list()
if (!is.null(p_anna)) plots_list_research[["Anna"]] <- p_anna
if (!is.null(p_lydia)) plots_list_research[["Lydia"]] <- p_lydia
if (!is.null(p_thomas)) plots_list_research[["Thomas"]] <- p_thomas

if (length(plots_list_research) > 0) {
  # Arrange plots in grid using wrap_plots
  combined_plots_research <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_list_research, ncol = 2)
  
  # Combine with legend on the right
  final_plot_research <- combined_plots_research | legend_plot_research
  final_plot_research <- final_plot_research + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))
  
  print(final_plot_research)
} else {
  cat("No plots were created for research questions.\n")
}
